title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八 明帝
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八 明帝 Volume 8 Annals 8: Emperor Ming

sentences.zh: 太宗明皇帝諱彧，字休炳，小字榮期，文帝第十一子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming, posthumous title Taizong, taboo name Yu, courtesy name Xiubing, childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming, posthumous title Taizong, whose personal name was Yu, courtesy name Xiubing, and childhood name Rongqi, was the eleventh son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十六年十月戊寅生。

translations.literal: He was born on wuyin day in the tenth month of the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the wuyin day of the tenth month in the sixteenth year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，封淮陽王，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year his title was changed to Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 元凶弒立，以為驍騎將軍，加給事中。

translations.literal: When the Assassin Prince seized the throne by murder, [the Prince] was made General of Galloping Cavalry and given the additional post of Supervisor of Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When the Assassin Prince murdered his way to the throne, the Prince was appointed General of Galloping Cavalry and given the additional post of Supervisor of Attendants.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，為祕書監，遷冠軍將軍、南蘭陵下邳二郡太守，領石頭戍事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu ascended the throne, [the Prince] was made Supervisor of the Palace Library, then promoted to General Who Conquers and Administrator of Nanlanling and Xiapi commanderies, concurrently holding the garrison command at Shitou.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, the Prince was made Supervisor of the Palace Library, then promoted to General Who Conquers and Administrator of Nanlanling and Xiapi, with concurrent command of the Shitou garrison.

sentences.zh: 孝建元年，徙為南彭城、東海二郡太守，將軍如故，鎮京口。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiaojian he was transferred as Administrator of Nan Pengcheng and Donghai commanderies; his rank as general was unchanged, and he was stationed at Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xiaojian he was reassigned as Administrator of Nan Pengcheng and Donghai while keeping his general's rank, and he was posted at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 其年，徵為中護軍。

translations.literal: That same year he was summoned to serve as Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he was recalled to serve as Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷侍中，領游擊將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary, concurrently holding the post of General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary and made General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare.

sentences.zh: 三年，徙衞尉，侍中如故。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Minister of the Guard; Attendant-in-Ordinary remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Minister of the Guard while retaining his post as Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 又為左衞將軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: He was also made General of the Left Guard; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He was also appointed General of the Left Guard while continuing as Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 大明元年，轉中護軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daming he was transferred to Colonel of the Garrison; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daming he was made Colonel of the Garrison while remaining Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 三年，為都官尚書，領游擊將軍，衞尉如故。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made Minister of Justice, concurrently General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare; Minister of the Guard remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Minister of Justice and General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare while still serving as Minister of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 八年，出為使持節、都督徐兗二州豫州之梁郡諸軍事、鎮北將軍、徐州刺史，給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was sent out with Bearer of the Staff with Full Powers, as Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for Xu and Yan provinces and Liang commandery in Yuzhou, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou, and granted one set of drums and pipes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was sent out bearing the staff with full powers as Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for Xu and Yan provinces and Liang commandery in Yuzhou, appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou, and granted one set of drums and pipes.

sentences.zh: 其年，徵為侍中、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: That year he was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was recalled as Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 未拜，復為領軍將軍，侍中如故。

translations.literal: Before accepting the appointment, he was again made General of the Palace Guard; Attendant-in-Ordinary remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the new post, he was again made General of the Palace Guard while remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 廢帝景和末，上入朝，被留停都。

translations.literal: At the end of Jinghe in the Deposed Emperor's reign, the Prince entered the capital for audience and was detained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jinghe era under the Deposed Emperor, the Prince came to court for an audience and was kept in the capital.

sentences.zh: 廢帝誅害宰輔，殺戮大臣，恒慮有圖之者，疑畏諸父，並拘之殿內，遇上無禮，事在文諸王傳。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor executed chief ministers and slaughtered great officials, constantly fearing plotters; suspicious and afraid of his uncles, he confined them all within the palace halls. Toward the Prince he was rude; the details are in the princes' biographies.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor killed chief ministers and slaughtered senior officials, always fearing conspirators. Suspicious of his uncles, he confined them within the palace halls and treated the Prince with gross disrespect; the full account appears in the biographies of the princes.

sentences.zh: 遂收上付廷尉，一宿被原。

translations.literal: Then the Prince was handed over to the Court of Justice; within one night he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince was then handed over to the Court of Justice, but within a single night he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 將加禍害者，前後非一。

translations.literal: Instances when harm was about to be inflicted upon him were not few, before and after.
translations.idiomatic: More than once, before and after, he narrowly escaped plans to destroy him.

sentences.zh: 既而害上意定，明旦便應就禍。

translations.literal: When it was finally decided to harm the Prince, the next morning he should have met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Deposed Emperor had settled on killing the Prince, he was to have been destroyed the very next morning.

sentences.zh: 上先已與腹心阮佃夫、李道兒等密共合謀。

translations.literal: The Prince had already secretly plotted together with his trusted men Ruan Tianfu, Li Dao'er, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince had already entered into a secret plot with his trusted followers Ruan Tianfu, Li Dao'er, and others.

sentences.zh: 于時廢帝左右常慮禍及，人人有異志。

translations.literal: At that time those around the Deposed Emperor constantly feared calamity would reach them; everyone had divergent intentions.
translations.idiomatic: By then those close to the Deposed Emperor lived in constant fear for their lives, and each man nursed his own separate design.

sentences.zh: 唯有直閤將軍宗越、譚金、童太一等數人為其腹心，並虓虎有幹力，在殿省久，眾並畏服之，故莫敢動。

translations.literal: Only Direct Attendant-General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, Tong Taiyi, and several others were his trusted men—all fierce tigers with capacity, long in palace service, all feared and submitted to—so none dared act.
translations.idiomatic: Only Direct Attendant-General Zong Yue, Tan Jin, Tong Taiyi, and a few others remained his trusted inner circle—men as fierce as tigers, strong in action, and long established in palace service, whom everyone feared and obeyed—so no one dared move against them.

sentences.zh: 是夕，越等並外宿。

translations.literal: That evening Yue and the others all lodged outside.
translations.idiomatic: That night Yue and the others were all billeted outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 佃夫、道兒因結壽寂之等殞廢帝於後堂。

translations.literal: Tianfu and Dao'er then joined with Shou Jizhi and others to kill the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: Tianfu and Dao'er then joined Shou Jizhi and others in killing the Deposed Emperor in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月二十九日夜也。

translations.literal: It was the night of the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: This took place on the night of the twenty-ninth day of the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 事定，上未知所為。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, the Prince did not yet know what to do.
translations.idiomatic: Once the deed was done, the Prince still did not know what he should do next.

sentences.zh: 建安王休仁便稱臣奉引升西堂，登御坐，召見諸大臣。

translations.literal: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an immediately declared himself subject and led him up to the Western Hall, mounted the imperial seat, and summoned the various great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an at once declared himself his subject, led him up to the Western Hall, seated him on the imperial throne, and summoned the senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 于時事起倉卒，上失履，跣至西堂，猶著烏帽。

translations.literal: At that time the affair arose in sudden haste; the Prince lost his shoes and went barefoot to the Western Hall, still wearing a black cap.
translations.idiomatic: The coup had erupted in sudden confusion: the Prince lost his shoes and ran barefoot to the Western Hall, still wearing a black cap.

sentences.zh: 坐定，休仁呼主衣以白帽代之，令備羽儀。

translations.literal: When seated, Xiuren called the Master of Imperial Wardrobes to replace it with a white cap and ordered the imperial guard of honor prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Once he was seated, Xiuren summoned the Master of Imperial Wardrobes to bring a white cap in its place and ordered the imperial guard of honor made ready.

sentences.zh: 雖未即位，凡眾事悉稱令書施行。

translations.literal: Although he had not yet ascended the throne, all matters were executed in the name of directoral orders.
translations.idiomatic: Although he had not yet formally ascended the throne, every affair was carried out under directoral orders in his name.

sentences.zh: 己未，司徒揚州刺史豫章王子尚、山陰公主並賜死。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Minister and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Zishang of Yuzhang and the Princess of Shanyin were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Minister and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Zishang of Yuzhang and the Princess of Shanyin were both ordered to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 宗越、譚金、童太一謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Yue, Tan Jin, and Tong Taiyi plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申朔，令書以司空東海王褘為中書監、太尉，鎮軍將軍、江州刺史晉安王子勛進號車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengshen, first day of the twelfth month, a directoral order made Grand Minister of Works Prince Kui of Donghai Supervisor of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal; General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Zixun of Jin'an was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the first of the twelfth month, a directoral order appointed Grand Minister of Works Prince Kui of Donghai Supervisor of the Secretariat and Grand Marshal, and promoted General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Zixun of Jin'an to General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以新除驃騎大將軍建安王休仁為司徒、尚書令、揚州刺史，鎮軍將軍、開府儀同三司山陽王休祐進號驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, newly appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Minister, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou; General Who Pacifies the Army with Staff equal to Three Divisions Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day newly appointed General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Minister, Director of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou, while General Who Pacifies the Army with protocol equal to a three-division office Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang was promoted to General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇憲衞尉桂陽王休範為鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Minister of the Guard for Chongxian Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Guard for Chongxian Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改封安陸王子綏為江夏王。

translations.literal: On yichou the enfeoffment of Prince Zisui of Anlu was changed to Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Prince Zisui of Anlu was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 泰始元年冬十二月丙寅，上即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the twelfth month of winter, first year of Taishi, the Prince ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the twelfth month in the first year of Taishi, the Prince ascended the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict said:
translations.idiomatic: An edict said:

sentences.zh: 高祖武皇帝德洞四瀛，化綿九服。

translations.literal: The High Ancestor Martial Emperor's virtue filled the four seas; his transforming influence extended to the nine domains.
translations.idiomatic: The High Ancestor Martial Emperor's virtue reached through the four seas, and his transforming influence spread across the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 太祖文皇帝以大明定基；

translations.literal: The Great Ancestor Civil Emperor secured the foundation with Daming;
translations.idiomatic: The Great Ancestor Civil Emperor established the dynasty's foundation in the Daming era;

sentences.zh: 世祖孝武皇帝以下武寧亂。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu with martial power quelled disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu with martial power quelled the realm's disorder.

sentences.zh: 日月所照，梯山航海；

translations.literal: Where sun and moon shine, they climbed mountains and sailed seas;
translations.idiomatic: Wherever sun and moon shone, men climbed mountains and crossed seas to submit;

sentences.zh: 風雨所均，削衽襲帶。

translations.literal: Where wind and rain reach, they cut their lapels and adjusted their sashes.
translations.idiomatic: wherever wind and rain fell, they cut their lapels and bound up their sashes in obedience.

sentences.zh: 所以業固盛漢，聲溢隆周。

translations.literal: Thus their enterprise surpassed flourishing Han; their renown overflowed august Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thus their achievement outshone the height of Han, and their fame surpassed the glory of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 子業凶嚚自天，忍悖成性，人面獸心，見於齠日，反道敗德，著自比年。

translations.literal: Ziye was vicious and stupid by nature from Heaven; cruelty and rebellion formed his character. A human face with a beast's heart appeared from childhood; perverse of the Way and ruined in virtue, this was evident these recent years.
translations.idiomatic: Ziye was savage and stupid from birth, cruelty and rebellion bred into his nature. Even as a child he showed a human face hiding a beast's heart; in recent years his perversity and moral ruin have become plain to all.

sentences.zh: 其狎侮五常，怠棄三正，矯誣上天，毒流下國，實開闢所未有，書契所未聞。

translations.literal: He trampled the five constants, abandoned the three orthodoxies, deceived Heaven on high, and poison flowed through the realm—truly never since the opening of the world, never heard of in written records.
translations.idiomatic: He trampled the five constants, cast aside the three orthodoxies, deceived Heaven itself, and let poison seep through the realm—deeds unheard of since the world began and unrecorded in any chronicle.

sentences.zh: 再罹遏密，而無一日之哀；

translations.literal: Twice he suffered the curtained seclusion, yet without a day's grief;
translations.idiomatic: Twice he entered the curtained mourning seclusion, yet never mourned for a single day;

sentences.zh: 齊斬在躬，方深北里之樂。

translations.literal: While hempen mourning garments were on his person, he deeply indulged in pleasures of the northern quarters.
translations.idiomatic: even while the hempen garments of deepest mourning were upon him, he abandoned himself to the pleasures of the pleasure quarters.

sentences.zh: 虎兕難匣，憑河必彰，遂誅滅上宰，窮釁逆之酷，虐害國輔，究孥戮之刑。

translations.literal: Tigers and rhinos could not be caged; relying on the river he must reveal himself—thus he executed and exterminated chief ministers, exhausting the cruelty of rebellion; abused and harmed state ministers, carrying out punishment to the extermination of families.
translations.idiomatic: Like a tiger or rhinoceros that no cage could hold, his cruelty could not be concealed—so he slaughtered chief ministers in the full extremity of treason, abused the pillars of state, and carried punishments to the annihilation of whole clans.

sentences.zh: 子鸞同生，以昔憾殄殪。

translations.literal: Ziluan was born of the same womb; because of a past grudge he was destroyed and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Ziluan was his own brother by the same mother, yet an old grievance moved him to destroy and kill him.

sentences.zh: 敬猷兄弟，以睚眦殲夷。

translations.literal: The brothers Jingyou were annihilated over a grudge in the eye.
translations.idiomatic: The brothers Jingyou were wiped out over the smallest slight.

sentences.zh: 徵逼義陽，將加屠膾。

translations.literal: He summoned and pressured Yiyang, intending to add slaughter and mincing.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned and pressed the Prince of Yiyang, intending to butcher and mince him.

sentences.zh: 陵辱戚藩，檟楚妃主。

translations.literal: He insulted and humiliated imperial princes by marriage, flogging princesses and consorts.
translations.idiomatic: He humiliated imperial princes related by marriage and flogged princesses and imperial consorts.

sentences.zh: 奪立左右，竊子置儲，肆酗于朝，宣淫于國。

translations.literal: He seized appointment of those around him, installed a bastard as heir, indulged in drunkenness at court, and spread lewdness through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: He placed his favorites in office, installed a bastard as heir apparent, drank to excess at court, and spread debauchery throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 事穢東陵，行汙飛走。

translations.literal: His conduct defiled Dongling; his deeds polluted flying and running creatures.
translations.idiomatic: His conduct shamed even the licentious tales of Dongling; his deeds befouled bird and beast alike.

sentences.zh: 積釁罔極，日月滋深。

translations.literal: Accumulated guilt without limit; day by day it deepened.
translations.idiomatic: His accumulated crimes knew no limit and deepened with every passing day.

sentences.zh: 比遂圖犯玄宮，志窺題湊，將肆梟、鏡之禍，騁商、頓之心。

translations.literal: Recently he then plotted to violate the spirit palace, his ambition spied at the imperial tally; he would unleash the punishments of dismemberment and boiling, and give free rein to the hearts of Shang and Dun.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he plotted to violate the imperial tombs and cast his eyes upon the throne itself; he would have unleashed punishments of dismemberment and boiling and indulged the cruelty of kings Shang and Li.

sentences.zh: 又欲鴆毒崇憲，虐加諸父，事均宮閫，聲遍國都。

translations.literal: He also wished to poison with zhen Prince Chongxian, extending cruelty to his uncles; the affair matched palace gates, and the rumor filled the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also planned to poison Prince Chongxian and extend his cruelty to his uncles; the plot touched the inner palace gates, and word of it filled the capital.

sentences.zh: 鴟梟小豎，莫不寵暱，朝廷忠誠，必也戮挫。

translations.literal: Owls, owlets, and petty lads—all were favored and intimate; loyal officials of the court were invariably slaughtered and thwarted.
translations.idiomatic: Owls, fledglings, and petty lads were all favored intimates, while loyal court officials were slaughtered without exception.

sentences.zh: 收掩之旨，虓虎結轍；

translations.literal: Orders for arrest and seizure—ferocious tigers linked wheel tracks;
translations.idiomatic: Orders for arrest and seizure went out in unbroken streams, like wheel tracks left by ravening tigers;

sentences.zh: 掠奪之使，白刃相望。

translations.literal: Envoys of plunder—naked blades faced one another.
translations.idiomatic: and plundering envoys went forth until naked blades confronted one another on every road.

sentences.zh: 百僚危氣，首領無有全地；

translations.literal: All officials lived in peril; none had ground to keep head intact;
translations.idiomatic: Every official lived in terror, with no safe ground on which to keep his head;

sentences.zh: 萬姓崩心，妻子不復相保。

translations.literal: The myriad people were heartsick; wives and children could no longer protect one another.
translations.idiomatic: and the common people were heartsick, unable even to protect their wives and children.

sentences.zh: 所以鬼哭山鳴，星鉤血降，神器殆於馭索，景祚危於綴旒。

translations.literal: Therefore ghosts wailed and mountains shrieked, stars hooked and blood fell; the sacred vessel nearly fell from the chariot reins, and the luminous fortune perilously hung from the tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Ghosts wailed and mountains screamed, stars bent and blood rained down; the sacred vessel nearly slipped from the charioteer's grasp, and the dynasty's fortune hung by a thread from the imperial tassels.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以安西將軍、南豫州刺史劉遵考為特進、右光祿大夫，輔國將軍、歷陽南譙二郡太守建平王景素為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Liu Zunkao was made Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace; General Who Assists the State and Administrator of Liyang and Nan Qiao commanderies Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Liu Zunkao was appointed Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and General Who Assists the State and Administrator of Liyang and Nan Qiao commanderies Prince Jingsu of Jianping was made Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以荊州刺史臨海王子頊為鎮軍將軍，南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍，[1]左衞將軍劉道隆為中護軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai was made General Who Pacifies the Army; Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army, [1] General of the Left Guard Liu Daolong was made Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army; Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army; [1] and General of the Left Guard Liu Daolong was appointed Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改封臨賀王子產為南平王，晉熙王子輿為廬陵王。

translations.literal: On xinwei the enfeoffment of Prince Zichan of Linhe was changed to Prince of Nanping; Prince Ziyu of Jinxi was changed to Prince of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Prince Zichan of Linhe was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping, and Prince Ziyu of Jinxi as Prince of Luling.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以尚書左僕射王景文為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On renshen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 新除中護軍劉道隆卒。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Colonel of the Garrison Liu Daolong died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Daolong, newly appointed Colonel of the Garrison, died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，[2]詔曰：「朕戡亂寧民，屬膺景祚。

translations.literal: On guiyou, [2] an edict said: "I have quelled disorder and settled the people, and have received the luminous fortune.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, [2] an edict said: "I have quelled disorder and brought peace to the people, and have received Heaven's luminous mandate.

sentences.zh: 鴻制初造，革道惟新。

translations.literal: The great design is first made; the Way is reformed with renewal alone.
translations.idiomatic: A new order is being forged, and the Way itself is being remade.

sentences.zh: 而國故頻罹，仁澤偏壅。

translations.literal: Yet the state suffered frequent calamities; benevolent grace was unevenly blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the state has suffered repeated calamities, and benevolent grace has not reached everywhere equally.

sentences.zh: 每鑒寐疚心，罔識攸濟。

translations.literal: Each reflection keeps me sleepless with guilt; I know not how to cross over.
translations.idiomatic: Each time I reflect on this I lie awake in guilt, not knowing how to set things right.

sentences.zh: 巡方問俗，弘政所先，可分遣大使，廣求民瘼，考守宰之良，採衡閭之善。

translations.literal: Touring the regions and inquiring into customs is the first priority in extending governance; imperial envoys may be dispatched separately on a wide scale to seek the people's afflictions, examine the goodness of governors and prefects, and collect the excellence of village lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Touring the realm and learning its customs must come first in good government. Let imperial envoys be sent out broadly to seek out the people's hardships, assess the merit of governors and magistrates, and gather reports of virtue from village lanes.

sentences.zh: 若獄犴淹枉，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: If prison cases long detain the wrongly accused, injuring people and harming teaching—they should report the matter in full.
translations.idiomatic: Where prison cases long detain the innocent and harm both the people and public morals, let the facts be reported in full.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨，癃殘六疾，不能自存者，郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, solitaries, the disabled and six kinds of affliction—those unable to support themselves—let commanderies and counties generously measure out relief.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, the disabled, and those suffering the six afflictions who cannot support themselves should receive generous measured relief from their commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 貞婦孝子，高行力田，詳悉條奏。

translations.literal: Chaste wives, filial sons, high conduct and hardworking farming—report in detail item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Chaste wives, filial sons, persons of outstanding conduct, and diligent farmers should be reported in full, item by item.

sentences.zh: [3]務詢輿誦，廣納嘉謀，每盡皇華之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: [3] Strive to inquire into songs from the lanes, widely receive excellent counsel; fully exhaust the intent of the imperial envoys, as though I personally examined them.
translations.idiomatic: [3] Hear the songs of the common people, welcome good counsel from every quarter, and let the envoys carry out their mission fully, as though I myself were reviewing each report.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，追尊所生沈婕妤曰宣皇太后。

translations.literal: " On yihai, the birth mother Lady Shen was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: " On the yihai day the Emperor's birth mother, Lady Shen, was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.

sentences.zh: 後軍將軍垣閎為司州刺史，前右將軍長史殷琰為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Rear Guard Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Si; former Chief Clerk of the General of the Right Yin Yan was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Rear Guard Yuan Hong was appointed Inspector of Si, and former Chief Clerk of the General of the Right Yin Yan was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「皇室多故，糜費滋廣，且久歲不登，公私歉弊。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict said: "The imperial house has many troubles; waste and expense grow ever broader; moreover harvests have failed for years; public and private are impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict said: "The imperial house has endured many troubles; waste and expense grow ever greater; harvests have failed for years, and both public and private coffers are exhausted.

sentences.zh: 方刻意從儉，弘濟時艱，政道未孚，慨愧兼積。

translations.literal: Now we deliberately practice austerity to broadly relieve the times' hardship; government Way is not yet trusted—in sighs and shame this accumulates.
translations.idiomatic: We must now deliberately practice austerity to relieve the hardship of the age, yet government has not yet won the people's trust—a burden of sighs and shame weighs upon us.

sentences.zh: 太官供膳，可詳所減撤，尚方御府雕文篆刻無益之物，一皆蠲省，務存簡約，以稱朕心。

translations.literal: The Chief Steward's provision of meals should be examined for detail on reductions; the Imperial Workshop and Palace Storehouse's carved inscriptions and seal engravings and useless items—all exempted and reduced; strive to preserve simplicity, to match my heart.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Chief Steward's provision of meals be reviewed in detail for cuts; let carved ornament, seal engraving, and every useless item in the Imperial Workshop and Palace Storehouse be abolished or reduced. Preserve simplicity in all things, as my heart desires.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，崇太后為崇憲皇太后。

translations.literal: " On wuyin, Empress Dowager Chong was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian.
translations.idiomatic: " On the wuyin day Empress Dowager Chong was elevated to Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian.

sentences.zh: 立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: Empress Wang was installed.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wang was installed.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍將軍、江州刺史晉安王子勛舉兵反，鎮軍長史鄧琬為其謀主，雍州刺史袁顗率眾赴之。

translations.literal: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou, raised troops in rebellion; Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Deng Wan was his chief plotter; Inspector of Yong Yuan Yi led troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiangzhou, rose in rebellion; Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Deng Wan was his chief strategist, and Inspector of Yong Yuan Yi marched to join him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，驃騎大將軍、前荊州刺史山陽王休祐改為江州刺史，荊州刺史臨海王子頊即留本任。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and former Inspector of Jingzhou, was changed to Inspector of Jiangzhou; Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai remained in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and former Inspector of Jingzhou, was reassigned as Inspector of Jiangzhou, while Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Zixu of Linhai remained in his original post.

sentences.zh: 加領軍將軍王玄謨鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕謁太廟。

translations.literal: On renwu, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the Emperor visited the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲申，後將軍、郢州刺史安陸王子綏進號征南將軍，右將軍、會稽太守尋陽王子房進號安東將軍，前將軍、荊州刺史臨海王子頊進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Rear General and Inspector of Ying Prince Zisui of Anlu was promoted to General Who Punishes the South; General of the Right and Administrator of Kuaiji Prince Zifang of Xunyang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East; General of the Van and Inspector of Jing Prince Zixu of Linhai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Rear General and Inspector of Ying Prince Zisui of Anlu was promoted to General Who Punishes the South; General of the Right and Administrator of Kuaiji Prince Zifang of Xunyang was promoted to General Who Pacifies the East; and General of the Van and Inspector of Jing Prince Zixu of Linhai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 子綏、子房、子頊並不受命，舉兵同逆。

translations.literal: Zisui, Zifang, and Zixu all refused the orders and raised troops in joint rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Zisui, Zifang, and Zixu all refused their appointments and rose in joint rebellion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，新除中軍將軍永嘉王子仁為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi, newly appointed General of the Center Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day newly appointed General of the Center Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己丑朔，以軍事不朝會。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, jichou first day of new moon—because of military affairs the court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the jichou day, the first of the first month of spring, the regular court audience was not held because of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以金紫光祿大夫王僧朗為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Senglang was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Senglang was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，驃騎大將軍、江州刺史山陽王休祐改為南豫州刺史，鎮歷陽。

translations.literal: On renchen, Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was changed to Inspector of Southern Yuzhou, stationed at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Prince Xiuyou of Shanyang, General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Yuzhou and posted at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 鎮軍將軍、領軍將軍王玄謨為車騎將軍、江州刺史，平北將軍、徐州刺史薛安都進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou; General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army and General of the Palace Guard Wang Xuamo was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou, and General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Xuzhou Xue Andu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 安都亦不受命。

translations.literal: Andu also refused the order.
translations.idiomatic: Andu also refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以左衞將軍巴陵王休若為鎮東將軍，新除安東將軍尋陽王子房為撫軍將軍，司徒左長史袁愍孫為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On guisi day General of the Left Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was made General Who Pacifies the East; newly appointed General Who Pacifies the East Prince Zifang of Xunyang was made General Who Stabilizes the Army; Left Chief Clerk of the Minister Yuan Minsun was made General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day General of the Left Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was appointed General Who Pacifies the East; the newly appointed General Who Pacifies the East Prince Zifang of Xunyang was made General Who Stabilizes the Army; and Left Chief Clerk of the Minister Yuan Minsun was appointed General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲午，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On jiawu day martial alert was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day martial alert was proclaimed throughout the capital and the provinces.

sentences.zh: 司徒建安王休仁都督征討諸軍事，統眾軍南討。

translations.literal: Minister Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren was made Commander-in-Chief of punitive expeditionary forces and led all armies south in punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the punitive expedition and led the combined armies south.

sentences.zh: 以青州刺史劉祗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Qing Liu Zhi was made Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Qing Liu Zhi was appointed Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以征虜司馬申令孫為徐州刺史，義陽內史龐孟虯為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Chief Clerk of the General Who Conquers the Barbarians Shen Lingsun was made Inspector of Xu, and Interior Administrator of Yiyang Pang Mengjiao was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Chief Clerk of the General Who Conquers the Barbarians Shen Lingsun was appointed Inspector of Xu, and Interior Administrator of Yiyang Pang Mengjiao was made Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 令孫、孟虯及豫州刺史殷琰、青州刺史沈文秀、冀州刺史崔道固、湘州行事何慧文、廣州刺史袁曇遠、益州刺史蕭惠開、梁州刺史柳元怙並同叛逆。

translations.literal: Lingsun, Mengjiao, and Inspector of Yu Yin Yan, Inspector of Qing Shen Wenxiu, Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu, Acting Inspector of Xiang He Huiwen, Inspector of Guang Yuan Tanyuan, Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai, and Inspector of Liang Liu Yuanhu all rebelled together.
translations.idiomatic: Lingsun, Mengjiao, and Inspector of Yu Yin Yan, Inspector of Qing Shen Wenxiu, Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu, Acting Inspector of Xiang He Huiwen, Inspector of Guang Yuan Tanyuan, Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai, and Inspector of Liang Liu Yuanhu all rose in joint rebellion.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史殷孝祖入衞京都，仍遣孝祖前鋒南伐。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yan Yin Xiaozu entered the capital to guard the imperial city, and Xiaozu was still dispatched as vanguard in the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yan Yin Xiaozu came to the capital to defend the imperial city, and was then sent south as vanguard of the punitive force.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，加孝祖撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Xiaozu was given the additional title General Who Stabilizes the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Yin Xiaozu was further promoted to General Who Stabilizes the Army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕親御六師，出頓中興堂。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the imperial carriage personally commanded the Six Armies and went out to encamp at Zhongxing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the Emperor personally took command of the Six Armies and encamped at Zhongxing Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，驃騎大將軍、南豫州刺史山陽王休祐改為豫州刺史，統眾軍西討。

translations.literal: On xinhai day General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was changed to Inspector of Yu and commanded all armies in the western punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Southern Yu Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was reassigned as Inspector of Yu and placed in command of the western punitive armies.

sentences.zh: 吳郡太守顧琛、吳興太守王曇生、義興太守劉延熙、晉陵太守袁摽、山陽太守程天祚並舉兵反。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wu Gu Chen, Administrator of Wuxing Wang Tansheng, Administrator of Yixing Liu Yanxi, Administrator of Jinling Yuan Biao, and Administrator of Shanyang Cheng Tianzuo all raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Wu Gu Chen, Administrator of Wuxing Wang Tansheng, Administrator of Yixing Liu Yanxi, Administrator of Jinling Yuan Biao, and Administrator of Shanyang Cheng Tianzuo all took up arms in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鎮東將軍巴陵王休若統眾軍東討。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the East Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo commanded all armies in the eastern punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the East Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo led the combined armies east in punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬子，崇憲皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On renzi day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian died.

sentences.zh: 是日，軍主任農夫、劉懷珍平定義興。

translations.literal: That same day army commanders Ren Nongfu and Liu Huaizhen pacified Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: That same day army commanders Ren Nongfu and Liu Huaizhen pacified Yixing.

sentences.zh: 永世縣民史逸宗據縣為逆，殿中將軍陸攸之討平之。

translations.literal: Shi Yizong, a commoner of Yongshi county, seized the county in rebellion; Palace General Lu Youzhi suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizong, a commoner of Yongshi county, seized the county in rebellion; Palace General Lu Youzhi put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以新除左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王僧朗為特進，左光祿大夫如故。

translations.literal: On bingchen day newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Senglang was made Special Grand Master, Left Grand Master of the Palace remaining unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Wang Senglang, newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office, was promoted to Special Grand Master while retaining his post as Left Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，僧朗卒。

translations.literal: Second month, yichou day—Senglang died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month Wang Senglang died.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王景文父憂去職。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen left office on account of his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen left office to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 曲赦吳、吳興、義興、晉陵四郡。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty was granted to the four commanderies of Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, and Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for the four commanderies of Wu, Wuxing, Yixing, and Jinling.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書蔡興宗為尚書左僕射，吳興太守張永、右軍將軍齊王東討，平晉陵。

translations.literal: Director of the Office of Personnel Cai Xingzong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Yong and General of the Right Prince of Qi marched east in punitive campaign and pacified Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Office of Personnel Cai Xingzong was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Administrator of Wuxing Zhang Yong and General of the Right the Prince of Qi marched east and pacified Jinling.

sentences.zh: 癸未，曲赦浙江東五郡。

translations.literal: On guiwei day partial amnesty was granted to the five commanderies east of the Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the five commanderies east of the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鎮東將軍巴陵王休若進號衞將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai day General Who Pacifies the East Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was promoted to General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day General Who Pacifies the East Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was promoted to General of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 建武將軍吳喜公率諸軍破賊於吳、吳興、會稽，平定三郡，同逆皆伏誅。

translations.literal: General Who Establishes Martial Power Wu Xigong led the armies and defeated the rebels in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacifying the three commanderies; all fellow rebels were executed.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Establishes Martial Power Wu Xigong led the armies to victory over the rebels in Wu, Wuxing, and Kuaiji, pacifying all three commanderies; every co-conspirator was put to death.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍齊王前鋒北討，輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State the Prince of Qi marched north as vanguard in punitive campaign; General Who Assists the State Liu Yao marched west as vanguard in punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State the Prince of Qi marched north as vanguard of the punitive force; General Who Assists the State Liu Yao marched west as vanguard.

sentences.zh: [4]賊劉胡領眾四萬據赭圻。

translations.literal: [4] The rebel Liu Hu commanded forty thousand men and held Zheqi.
translations.idiomatic: [4] The rebel Liu Hu led a force of forty thousand and occupied Zheqi.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻，死之。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin day—General Who Stabilizes the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zheqi and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the third month General Who Stabilizes the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zheqi and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒。

translations.literal: General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was made vanguard of the southern punitive campaign in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was appointed southern vanguard in his place.

sentences.zh: [5]賊眾稍盛，袁顗頓鵲尾，聯營迄至濃湖，眾十餘萬。

translations.literal: [5] The rebel forces grew stronger by the day; Yuan Yan encamped at Quewei, his linked camps stretching all the way to Nonghu, with more than one hundred thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: [5] The rebel armies swelled daily; Yuan Yan held Quewei, and his linked encampments stretched from there to Nonghu, numbering more than one hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以新除太子詹事張永為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen day newly appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Zhang Yong, newly appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範總統北討諸軍事。

translations.literal: On bingshen day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was made overall commander of the northern punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was placed in overall command of the northern punitive armies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以尚書劉思考為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Sikao was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Sikao was appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶尋陽王子房爵為松滋縣侯。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zifang of Xunyang was demoted in rank to Marquis of Songzi county.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Prince Zifang of Xunyang was stripped of his princely title and demoted to Marquis of Songzi county.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以奉朝請鄭黑為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi day Bearer of Court Audience Zheng Hei was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Bearer of Court Audience Zheng Hei was appointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鎮北將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was also made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was also given the post of Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，斷新錢，專用古錢。

translations.literal: On renzi day new coinage was abolished; only old coin was to be used.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day new coinage was abolished and only old coin permitted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，原赦揚、南徐二州囚繫，凡逋亡一無所問。

translations.literal: On guichou day prisoners in Yang and Southern Xu were pardoned; all fugitives were exempt from inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day prisoners in Yang and Southern Xu were pardoned, and all fugitives were granted immunity from prosecution.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，以散騎侍郎明僧暠為青州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renwu day—Attendant Cadet at the Palace Library Ming Senghao was made Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the fourth month of summer Attendant Cadet at the Palace Library Ming Senghao was appointed Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，以輔國將軍沈攸之為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renchen day—General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the fifth month General Who Assists the State Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，曲赦豫州。

translations.literal: On dingyou day partial amnesty was granted to Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yu province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，新除尚書僕射王景文為中軍將軍，以青、冀二州刺史張永為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei day newly appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Jingwen was made General of the Center Army; Inspector of Qing and Ji Zhang Yong was made General Who Stabilizes the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Wang Jingwen, newly appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Qing and Ji Zhang Yong was promoted to General Who Stabilizes the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以寧朔將軍劉乘民為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu day General Who Calms the North Liu Chenmin was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day General Who Calms the North Liu Chenmin was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian was buried at Xiuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Grand Empress Dowager Chongxian was interred at Xiuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: [6]冠軍將軍、益州刺史蕭惠開進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: [6] General Who Conquers the Enemy and Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: [6] General Who Conquers the Enemy and Inspector of Yi Xiao Huikai was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，鎮軍將軍張永領徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinyou day—General Who Stabilizes the Army Zhang Yong was also made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the sixth month General Who Stabilizes the Army Zhang Yong was also appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 京師雨水，丁卯，遣殿中將軍檢行賜卹。

translations.literal: Rain flooded the capital; on dingmao day palace generals were dispatched on inspection tours to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Floods inundated the capital; on the dingmao day palace generals were sent out on inspection tours to distribute relief.

sentences.zh: 以左軍將軍垣恭祖為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: General of the Left Army Yuan Gongzu was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Left Army Yuan Gongzu was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，鎮北將軍、南徐兗二州刺史桂陽王休範進號征北大將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jichou day—General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was promoted to General Who Conquers the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the seventh month of autumn General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan was promoted to General Who Conquers the North.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮軍將軍、徐州刺史張永改為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao day General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Xu Zhang Yong was changed to Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Xu Zhang Yong was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以仇池太守楊僧嗣為北秦州刺史、武都王。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Administrator of Qiuchi Yang Sengsi was made Inspector of Northern Qin and Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Administrator of Qiuchi Yang Sengsi was appointed Inspector of Northern Qin and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以男子時朗之為北豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin day the commoner Shi Langzhi was made Inspector of Northern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the commoner Shi Langzhi was appointed Inspector of Northern Yu.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，龍驤將軍劉道符平山陽。

translations.literal: On yisi day General of Flying Cavalry Liu Daofu pacified Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day General of Flying Cavalry Liu Daofu pacified Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，又以義軍主鄭叔舉為北豫州刺史，鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史張永復領徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Volunteer Army Commander Zheng Shuju was again made Inspector of Northern Yu; General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Southern Yan Zhang Yong again held the post of Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Volunteer Army Commander Zheng Shuju was again appointed Inspector of Northern Yu; General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Southern Yan Zhang Yong resumed the post of Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復以冀州刺史崔道固為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was again made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was again appointed Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，司徒建安王休仁率眾軍大破賊，斬偽尚書僕射袁顗，進討江、郢、荊、雍、湘五州，平定之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jimao day—Minister Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren led the armies to a great victory over the rebels, beheaded the false Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Yan, and advanced to punish Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang—pacifying all five provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the eighth month Minister Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren led the armies to a crushing victory over the rebels, beheaded the rebel Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Yan, and advanced to subdue Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang, pacifying all five provinces.

sentences.zh: 晉安王子勛、安陸王子綏、臨海王子頊、邵陵王子元並賜死，同黨皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, Prince Zisui of Anlu, Prince Zixu of Linhai, and Prince Ziyuan of Shaoling were all granted death; all fellow conspirators were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zixun of Jin'an, Prince Zisui of Anlu, Prince Zixu of Linhai, and Prince Ziyuan of Shaoling were all ordered to take their own lives; every co-conspirator was put to death.

sentences.zh: 諸將軍帥封賞各有差。

translations.literal: Generals and commanders received enfeoffments and rewards in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: The generals and commanders received enfeoffments and rewards according to their merit.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以護軍將軍、永嘉王子仁為平南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiashen day General Who Protects the Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day General Who Protects the Army Prince Ziren of Yongjia was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，曲赦江、郢、荊、雍、湘五州；

translations.literal: Ninth month, yiyou day—partial amnesty was granted to Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang provinces;
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the ninth month a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Jiang, Ying, Jing, Yong, and Xiang provinces;

sentences.zh: 守宰不得離職。

translations.literal: local administrators were not permitted to leave their posts.
translations.idiomatic: local administrators were forbidden to leave their posts.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，驃騎大將軍、豫州刺史山陽王休祐改為荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen day General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Yu Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was changed to Inspector of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast and Inspector of Yu Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was reassigned as Inspector of Jing.

sentences.zh: 分豫州立南豫州。

translations.literal: From Yu province Southern Yu province was established.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yu province was carved out of Yu province.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，六軍解嚴。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Six Armies stood down from martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the Six Armies were released from martial alert.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜民爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire; the people were granted one step in noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire, and the common people were granted one step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以中軍將軍王景文為安南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiawu day General of the Center Army Wang Jingwen was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day General of the Center Army Wang Jingwen was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以車騎將軍、江州刺史王玄謨為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Wang Xuanmo was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Wang Xuanmo was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Heir Apparent of Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren, Boyong, was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Boyong, heir of Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren, was appointed Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: [7]辛丑，衞將軍巴陵王休若即本號為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: [7] On xinchou day General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo took his existing title and became Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: [7] On the xinchou day General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo retained his existing rank and was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yong Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yong Shen Youzhi was reassigned as Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以太子左衞率建平王景素為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Leader of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent Prince Jianping Wang Jingsu was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Leader of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent Prince Jianping Wang Jingsu was appointed Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，永嘉王子仁、始安王子真、淮南王子孟、南平王子產、廬陵王子輿、松滋侯子房並賜死。

translations.literal: Tenth month, yimao day—Prince Ziren of Yongjia, Prince Zizhen of Shi'an, Prince Zimeng of Huainan, Prince Zichan of Nanping, Prince Ziyu of Luling, and Marquis Zifang of Songzi were all granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the tenth month Prince Ziren of Yongjia, Prince Zizhen of Shi'an, Prince Zimeng of Huainan, Prince Zichan of Nanping, Prince Ziyu of Luling, and Marquis Zifang of Songzi were all ordered to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以郢州刺史沈攸之為中領軍，與張永俱北討。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was made General of the Palace Guard and marched north in punitive campaign together with Zhang Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was appointed General of the Palace Guard and marched north with Zhang Yong on punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Administrator of Wu Gu Qinzhi was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Administrator of Wu Gu Qinzhi was appointed Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: [8]戊寅，立皇子昱為皇太子。

translations.literal: [8] On wuyin day the Prince Yu was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: [8] On the wuyin day Prince Yu was installed as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚、南徐二州。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty was granted to Yang and Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yang and Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: [9]以輔國將軍劉勔為廣州刺史，左軍將軍張世為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: [9] General Who Assists the State Liu Yao was made Inspector of Guang; General of the Left Army Zhang Shi was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: [9] General Who Assists the State Liu Yao was appointed Inspector of Guang, and General of the Left Army Zhang Shi was made Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，以安成太守劉襲為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen day—Administrator of Ancheng Liu Xi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the eleventh month Administrator of Ancheng Liu Xi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔曰：「治崇簡易，化疾繁侈，遠關隆替，明著軌跡者也。

translations.literal: On renchen day an edict said: "Governance should honor simplicity and ease; transformation should hasten away from elaborate excess—this bears on rise and fall across the ages, and the traces are clear.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict said: "Good government honors simplicity and ease; true transformation must drive out elaborate excess—the rise and fall of dynasties turns on this, and the lesson is plain.

sentences.zh: 朕拯斯墜運，屬此屯極，仍之以凋耗，因之以師旅，而識昧前王，務艱昔代。

translations.literal: I have rescued this fallen fortune and inherited this hour of utmost peril; upon exhaustion and depletion have been piled the burdens of campaigning, yet my understanding falls short of the former kings and my tasks outmatch those of earlier ages.
translations.idiomatic: I have inherited a realm in collapse and an hour of utmost peril; upon exhaustion and depletion have been piled the burdens of war, yet my understanding falls short of the former kings and my tasks outmatch those of earlier ages.

sentences.zh: 俾夫舊賦既繁，為費彌廣，鑒寐萬務，每思弘革。

translations.literal: Thus old levies have grown ever more numerous and expenditures ever broader; reviewing the myriad affairs day and night, I constantly think of broad reform.
translations.idiomatic: Old levies have grown ever heavier and expenditures ever broader; reviewing the myriad affairs of state, I constantly seek broad reform.

sentences.zh: 方欲緩繇優調，愛民為先，有司詳加寬惠，更立科品。

translations.literal: I intend to ease corvée and lighten assessments, putting love of the people first; the responsible offices should examine matters in detail and add leniency and grace, establishing new categories and grades.
translations.idiomatic: I intend to ease corvée labor and lighten tax assessments, putting the welfare of the people first; let the responsible offices examine every measure in detail, grant leniency and grace, and establish new categories of obligation.

sentences.zh: 其方物職貢，各順土宜，出獻納貢，[10]敬依時令。

translations.literal: Local products and official tribute should each follow local suitability; what is offered and what is submitted as tribute [10] should respectfully follow the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Local products and official tribute should each suit local conditions; all offerings and tribute submissions [10] must respectfully follow the seasons.

sentences.zh: 凡諸蠹俗妨民之事，趣末違本之業，雕華靡麗，奇器異技，並嚴加裁斷，務歸要實。

translations.literal: All harmful customs that obstruct the people, pursuits of the secondary that betray the root, carved ornament and wasteful splendor, strange vessels and exotic skills—all shall be strictly curtailed, striving to return to what is essential and real.
translations.idiomatic: Every harmful custom that obstructs the people, every pursuit of profit that abandons the essential, every carved ornament and wasteful splendor, every strange vessel and exotic skill—all shall be strictly curtailed, until affairs return to what is essential and real.

sentences.zh: 左右尚方御府諸署，供御制造，咸存儉約。

translations.literal: The various offices of the Left and Right Imperial Workshops and Palace Storehouse, in supplying and manufacturing for the court, should all preserve thrift.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Imperial Workshops, the Palace Storehouse, and all supplying offices shall preserve thrift in everything manufactured for the court.

sentences.zh: 庶淳風至教，微遵太古，阜財興讓，少敦季俗。

translations.literal: Thus may the pure wind of highest teaching faintly follow the remotest antiquity; wealth may be heaped up and yielding encouraged, and the vulgar ways of the age somewhat restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Thus may the pure wind of highest teaching faintly echo remotest antiquity; wealth may be gathered and mutual yielding encouraged, and the vulgar ways of the age somewhat restrained.

sentences.zh: 」又詔曰：「夫秉機詢政，[11]立教之攸本；

translations.literal: " Another edict said: "To grasp the moment and inquire into governance [11] is the root of establishing teaching;
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict said: "To grasp the moment and inquire into governance [11] is the root of establishing teaching;

sentences.zh: 舉賢聘逸，弘化之所基。

translations.literal: to raise the worthy and invite the reclusive is the foundation of broadening transformation.
translations.idiomatic: to raise the worthy and invite the reclusive is the foundation of spreading transformation.

sentences.zh: 故負鼎進策，殷代以康；

translations.literal: Thus when one shouldered the cauldron and offered counsel, the Yin dynasty found peace;
translations.idiomatic: When Yi Yin shouldered the cauldron and offered counsel, the Yin dynasty found peace;

sentences.zh: 釋釣作輔，周祚斯乂。

translations.literal: when one cast aside the fishing line and became minister, the Zhou fortune was set right.
translations.idiomatic: when Jiang Ziya cast aside his fishing line and became minister, the Zhou fortune was set right.

sentences.zh: 朕甫承大業，訓道未敷，雖側席忠規，竚夢巖築，而良圖莫薦，奇士弗聞，永鑒通古，無忘宵寐。

translations.literal: I have just inherited the great enterprise; instruction and the Way are not yet spread abroad. Though I sit sideways awaiting loyal counsel and stand in dream awaiting men from the cliffs, yet no fine plan is offered and no extraordinary man is heard of—I forever take antiquity as mirror and never forget my sleepless nights.
translations.idiomatic: I have just inherited the great enterprise, and instruction has not yet spread throughout the realm. Though I sit sideways awaiting loyal counsel and stand in dream awaiting sages from the cliffs, no fine plan is offered and no extraordinary man comes forward—I take antiquity as my mirror and never forget my sleepless nights.

sentences.zh: 今藩隅克晏，敷化維始，屢懷存治，實望箴闕。

translations.literal: Now the frontier regions are pacified and the spreading of transformation is just beginning; repeatedly I harbor thoughts of good governance and truly look to be admonished where I fall short.
translations.idiomatic: Now the frontier regions are pacified and the work of transformation is just beginning; I constantly seek good governance and truly welcome admonition wherever I fall short.

sentences.zh: 王公卿尹，羣僚庶官，其有嘉謀直獻，匡俗濟時，咸切事陳奏，無或依隱。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, ministers, and chief officials, and all ranks of officials—whoever has excellent counsel offered directly, who can reform customs and aid the age, let all submit memorials on concrete matters without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, ministers, and officials of every rank—whoever has excellent counsel to offer, whoever can reform customs and aid the age, let all submit concrete memorials without concealment.

sentences.zh: 若乃林澤貞栖，丘園耿潔，博洽古今，敦崇孝讓，四方在任，可明書搜揚，具即以聞，隨就褒立。

translations.literal: As for those who dwell in chaste seclusion in forest and marsh, who maintain pure integrity in garden and field, who are broadly versed in antiquity and the present and earnestly honor filial piety and yielding—wherever they hold office in the four directions, let written orders clearly seek and raise them, report each case at once, and confer reward and rank as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: As for those who dwell in chaste seclusion in forest and marsh, who maintain pure integrity in garden and field, who are broadly versed in antiquity and the present and earnestly honor filial piety and yielding—wherever they hold office in the four directions, let written orders seek them out and raise them up, report each case at once, and confer reward and rank as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」以建平王景素子延年為新安王。

translations.literal: " Prince Jianping Wang Jingsu's son Yanian was made Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: " Yanian, son of Prince Jianping Wang Jingsu, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 以新除左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王玄謨為車騎將軍、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Xuanmo was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xuanmo, newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制使東土經荒流散，並各還本，蠲眾調二年。

translations.literal: On bingshen day an order was issued that those who had been scattered by famine in the eastern regions should each return to their native places, and the general levy was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an order was issued that those scattered by famine in the eastern regions should each return home, and the general levy was remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，以尚書金部郎劉善明為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiwei day—Director of the Gold Bureau Liu Shanming was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the twelfth month Director of the Gold Bureau Liu Shanming was appointed Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「近眾藩稱亂，多染釁科。

translations.literal: On yichou day an edict said: "Recently many princely domains rose in rebellion and many were stained by charges of treason.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict said: "Recently many princely domains rose in rebellion, and many were stained by charges of treason.

sentences.zh: 或誠係本朝，事緣逼迫，混同證錮，良以悵然。

translations.literal: Some were truly loyal to the dynasty but acted under compulsion; to treat them all alike in proof and imprisonment is truly a cause for regret.
translations.idiomatic: Some were truly loyal to the dynasty but acted under compulsion; to treat them all alike in proof and imprisonment is truly cause for regret.

sentences.zh: 夫天道尚仁，德刑並用，雷霆時至，雲雨必解。

translations.literal: Heaven's Way honors benevolence; virtue and punishment are employed together—when thunderclap comes in season, rain must follow and release.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's Way honors benevolence; virtue and punishment are employed together—when the thunderclap comes in season, the rain must follow and release.

sentences.zh: 朕眷言靜念，思弘風澤，凡應禁削，皆從原蕩。

translations.literal: Reflecting in quiet, I think to spread wind and grace; all who should suffer prohibition and reduction shall receive pardon and absolution.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting in quiet, I seek to spread grace throughout the realm; all who should suffer prohibition and reduction shall receive pardon and absolution.

sentences.zh: 其文武堪能，隨才銓用。

translations.literal: Those skilled in civil and military matters shall be appointed according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Those skilled in civil and military affairs shall be appointed according to their talents.

sentences.zh: 」辛未，以新除廣州刺史劉勔為益州刺史，前巴西、梓潼二郡太守費混為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: " On xinwei day newly appointed Inspector of Guang Liu Yao was made Inspector of Yi; former Administrator of Baxi and Zitong Fei Hun was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: " On the xinwei day Liu Yao, newly appointed Inspector of Guang, was reassigned as Inspector of Yi; former Administrator of Baxi and Zitong Fei Hun was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 劉勔克壽陽，豫州平。

translations.literal: Liu Yao captured Shouyang; Yu province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yao captured Shouyang and Yu province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi day General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day General Who Assists the State Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: [12]薛安都要引索虜，張永、沈攸之大敗，於是遂失淮北四州及豫州淮西地。

translations.literal: [12] Xue Andu intended to summon the Northern barbarians; Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi suffered great defeat, and thus the four provinces north of the Huai and the lands west of the Huai in Yu province were lost.
translations.idiomatic: [12] Xue Andu sought to bring in the Northern barbarians; Zhang Yong and Shen Youzhi suffered crushing defeat, and the dynasty lost the four provinces north of the Huai and the Huai-western territories of Yu province.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，以農役將興，太官停宰牛。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, gengzi day—because agricultural labor was about to begin, the Chief Steward ceased slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the gengzi day of the first month of spring, because agricultural labor was about to begin, the Chief Steward ceased slaughtering cattle.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，曲赦豫、南豫二州。

translations.literal: On guimao day partial amnesty was granted to Yu and Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yu and Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍巴陵王休若降號鎮西將軍。

translations.literal: General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was demoted in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was demoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，京師大雨雪，遣使巡行，賑賜各有差。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, gengwu day—heavy rain and snow fell in the capital; envoys were dispatched on inspection tours, and relief grants varied in measure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the intercalary month heavy rain and snow fell in the capital; envoys were sent on inspection tours and relief was distributed according to need.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以游擊將軍垣閎為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was appointed Inspector of Yi.

translations.literal: [13] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi: in all editions "Yuan Hong" reads "Yuan Lang." Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "Yuan Lang was already killed by Prince Jingling Wang Dan in the third year of Daming, as recorded in the biography of Yuan Huzhi. This should be Yuan Hong." Following Zhang's view, the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: [13] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yi: all editions read "Yuan Lang" for "Yuan Hong." Zhang Senkai notes that Yuan Lang was killed by Prince Jingling Wang Dan in the third year of Daming (see the biography of Yuan Huzhi); this should read Yuan Hong. The text is corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，以御史中丞羊希為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, jiashen day—Director of the Censorate Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the second month Director of the Censorate Yang Xi was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: [14]是日，車駕為戰亡將士舉哀。

translations.literal: [14] That same day the imperial carriage held mourning for officers and soldiers who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: [14] That same day the Emperor held mourning rites for officers and soldiers who died in battle.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以鎮西司馬劉亮為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jichou day Chief Clerk of the Pacifying West Army Liu Liang was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Chief Clerk of the Pacifying West Army Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 索虜寇汝陰，太守張景遠擊破之。

translations.literal: The Northern barbarians raided Ruyin; Administrator Zhang Jingyuan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern barbarians raided Ruyin; Administrator Zhang Jingyuan routed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，曲赦青、冀二州。

translations.literal: On bingshen day partial amnesty was granted to Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，以尚書左僕射蔡興宗為安西將軍、郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, bingzi day—Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the third month Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以冠軍將軍王玄載為徐州刺史，寧朔將軍崔平為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day General Who Conquers the Enemy Wang Xuanzai was made Inspector of Xu; General Who Calms the North Cui Ping was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day General Who Conquers the Enemy Wang Xuanzai was appointed Inspector of Xu, and General Who Calms the North Cui Ping was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，以前司州刺史鄭黑為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi day—former Inspector of Si Zheng Hei was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month of summer former Inspector of Si Zheng Hei was reappointed Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 乙未，冠軍將軍、北秦州刺史楊僧嗣進號征西將軍。

translations.literal: On yiwei day General Who Conquers the Enemy and Inspector of Northern Qin Yang Sengsi was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day General Who Conquers the Enemy and Inspector of Northern Qin Yang Sengsi was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: 庚子，立桂陽王休範第二子德嗣為廬陵王，立侍中劉韞第二子銑為南豐王。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Desi, second son of Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan, was established as Prince of Luling; Yao, second son of Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun, was established as Prince of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Desi, second son of Prince Guiyang Wang Xiufan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling; Yao, second son of Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 丙午，安西將軍蔡興宗降號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On bingwu day General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong was demoted in rank to General Who Levels the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong was demoted to General Who Levels the West.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，宣太后崇寧陵禁內墳屋瘞遷徙者，給葬直，蠲復家丁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingchen day—within the forbidden precinct of Empress Dowager Xuan's Chongning Mausoleum, those who had buried or moved grave dwellings were granted burial expenses, and household corvée was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the fifth month, within the forbidden precinct of Empress Dowager Xuan's Chongning Mausoleum, those who had buried or moved grave dwellings were granted burial expenses and their households exempted from corvée.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以車騎將軍、南豫州刺史王玄謨為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On wuwu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Wang Xuanmo was made Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yu Wang Xuanmo was appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷南豫州并豫州。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Southern Yu province was abolished and merged into Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Southern Yu province was abolished and merged into Yu province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以太子詹事袁粲為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On renxu day Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Can was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Yuan Can was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，以侍中劉韞為湘州刺史。
