translations.literal: Sixth month, yiyou day—Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was appointed Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，以左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司王玄謨為特進、左光祿大夫、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renzi day—Left Grand Master of the Palace with Staff equal to Three Divisions Wang Xuanmo was made Special Grand Master, Left Grand Master of the Palace, and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the seventh month of autumn Wang Xuanmo, Left Grand Master of the Palace with protocol equal to a three-division office, was promoted to Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace and appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 薛安都子伯令略據雍州四郡，刺史巴陵王休若討斬之。

translations.literal: Xue Andu's son Boling briefly held four commanderies of Yong; Inspector Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo suppressed and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Andu's son Boling briefly seized four commanderies of Yong; Inspector Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo suppressed the revolt and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔曰：「古者衡虞置制，蝝蚳不收；

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou day—an edict said: "In antiquity the forest and lake officers established regulations: even tiny creatures were not gathered;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingyou day—an edict said: "In antiquity the forest and lake officers established regulations: even the smallest creatures were not gathered;

sentences.zh: 川澤產育，登器進御。

translations.literal: what rivers and marshes produced was brought forth and presented at court.
translations.idiomatic: what rivers and marshes produced was brought forth and presented at court.

sentences.zh: 所以繁阜民財，養遂生德。

translations.literal: Thus the people's wealth was heaped up and the virtue of nurturing life was fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the people's wealth was heaped up and the virtue of nurturing life was fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 頃商販逐末，競早爭新，折未實之菓，收豪家之利，籠非膳之翼，為戲童之資。

translations.literal: Recently merchants pursued the secondary and competed to harvest early and rush the new, plucking unripe fruit, seizing great families' profits, caging birds unfit for the table, and making them resources for child entertainers.
translations.idiomatic: Recently merchants pursued profit over substance and competed to harvest early and rush the new—plucking unripe fruit, seizing great families' profits, caging birds unfit for the table, and turning them into toys for child entertainers.

sentences.zh: 豈所以還風尚本，捐華務實。

translations.literal: How can this restore the wind and honor the root, abandon ornament and pursue substance?
translations.idiomatic: How can this restore proper values and honor the essential, abandoning ornament for substance?

sentences.zh: 宜修道布仁，以革斯蠹。

translations.literal: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to reform this corruption.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to cultivate the Way and spread benevolence to reform this corruption.

sentences.zh: 自今鱗介羽毛，肴核眾品，非時月可採，器味所須，可一皆禁斷，嚴為科制。

translations.literal: From now on fish, shellfish, feathers, furs, meats, fruits, and all varieties—not what the seasons permit, not what vessels and flavors require—shall one and all be forbidden and cut off, with strict statutes established.
translations.idiomatic: From now on fish, shellfish, feathers, furs, meats, fruits, and all varieties—not what the seasons permit, not what table and palate require—shall one and all be forbidden, with strict statutes established.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，以中領軍沈攸之行南兗州刺史，率眾北討。

translations.literal: " On renyin day General of the Palace Guard Shen Youzhi acted as Inspector of Southern Yan and led the armies north in punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: " On the renyin day General of the Palace Guard Shen Youzhi acted as Inspector of Southern Yan and led the armies north on punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔曰：「法網之用，期世而行，寬惠之道，因時而布。

translations.literal: On guimao day an edict said: "The use of the legal net is timed to the age; the path of leniency and grace is spread according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day an edict said: "The use of the legal net is timed to the age; the path of leniency and grace is spread according to the times.

sentences.zh: 況朕尚德戡亂，依仁馭俗，宜每就弘簡，以隆至治。

translations.literal: Moreover I honor virtue and quell disorder, governing the people by benevolence—it is fitting always to seek breadth and simplicity to elevate the highest governance.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover I honor virtue and quell disorder, governing the people by benevolence—it is fitting always to seek breadth and simplicity to achieve the highest governance.

sentences.zh: 而頻罹兵革，繇賦未休，軍民巧偽，興事甚多，蹈刑入憲，諒非一科。

translations.literal: Yet repeatedly we have suffered warfare; corvée and levies have not ceased; soldiers and people practice cunning and falsehood, and affairs arising are very many; those who tread punishment and enter the statutes are surely not of one category alone.
translations.idiomatic: Yet repeatedly we have suffered warfare; corvée and levies have not ceased; soldiers and people practice cunning and falsehood, and new abuses multiply; those who fall under punishment and enter the statutes are surely not of one category alone.

sentences.zh: 至乃假名戎伍，竊爵私庭，因戰散亡，託懼逃役。

translations.literal: Some even borrow names in the army ranks, steal titles in private halls, use the scattering of battle to flee, and plead fear to evade service.
translations.idiomatic: Some even borrow names in the army rolls, steal titles in private halls, exploit the chaos of battle to flee, and plead fear to evade service.

sentences.zh: 且往諸淪逼，雖經累宥，逋竄之黨，猶為實繁。

translations.literal: Moreover those who were overrun and compelled in the past, though repeatedly pardoned, the party of fugitives is still truly numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover those who were overrun and compelled in the past, though repeatedly pardoned, the ranks of fugitives remain truly numerous.

sentences.zh: 宵言永懷，良兼矜疚。

translations.literal: Night words and long brooding bring me deep compassion and guilt together.
translations.idiomatic: Night after night I brood upon this with deep compassion and guilt.

sentences.zh: 思所以重播至澤，覃被區宇。

translations.literal: I think therefore to spread grace anew and extend it through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: I think therefore to spread grace anew and extend it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Let a general amnesty be proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 」加新除左光祿大夫王玄謨車騎將軍。

translations.literal: " Newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Xuanmo was given the additional title General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Xuanmo, newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace, was further promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣吏部尚書褚淵慰勞緣淮將帥，隨宜量賜。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Director of the Office of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to comfort and reward the commanders along the Huai, granting rewards as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Director of the Office of Personnel Chu Yuan was dispatched to comfort and reward the commanders along the Huai, with grants measured to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除右衞將軍劉勔為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen day newly appointed General of the Right Guard Liu Yao was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Liu Yao, newly appointed General of the Right Guard, was made Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，鎮西將軍、雍州刺史巴陵王休若進號衞將軍，平西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day—General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was promoted to General of the Guard; General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the ninth month General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yong Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was promoted to General of the Guard, and General Who Levels the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以越騎校尉周寧民為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao day Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以皇后六宮以下雜衣千領，金釵千枚，班賜北征將士。

translations.literal: On wuwu day one thousand sets of miscellaneous garments from the empress and the six palaces downward and one thousand gold hairpins were distributed in grant to the northern expedition officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day one thousand sets of miscellaneous garments from the empress and the six palaces downward and one thousand gold hairpins were distributed to the officers and soldiers of the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前將軍兼冀州刺史崔道固進號平北將軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen day former General of the Van and concurrent Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day former General of the Van and concurrent Inspector of Ji Cui Daogu was promoted to General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 甲子，曲赦徐、兗、青、冀四州。

translations.literal: On jiazi day partial amnesty was granted to Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，改封新安王延年為始平王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renwu day—Prince Yanian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the tenth month of winter Prince Yanian of Xin'an was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊子，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Rouran state sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the Rouran state sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復郡縣公田。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the public fields of commanderies and counties were restored.

sentences.zh: 鎮西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted to General Who Conquers the West.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立建安王休仁第二子伯猷為江夏王，改封義陽王昶為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month—Boyou, second son of Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren, was established as Prince of Jiangxia; Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Boyou, second son of Prince Jian'an Wang Xiuren, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia, and Prince Chang of Yiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分徐州置東徐州，以輔國將軍張讜為刺史。

translations.literal: On yimao day Eastern Xu province was established from Xu province; General Who Assists the State Zhang Tan was made inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day Eastern Xu province was carved out of Xu province; General Who Assists the State Zhang Tan was appointed its inspector.

sentences.zh: 高麗國、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The states of Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Goguryeo and Baekje sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，以寧朔將軍劉休賓為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengchen day—General Who Calms the North Liu Xiubin was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the twelfth month General Who Calms the North Liu Xiubin was appointed Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月己未，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, jiwei day—the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar; a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the jiwei day of the first month of spring, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburban Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 庚午，衞將軍巴陵王休若降號左將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu day General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was demoted in rank to General of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day General of the Guard Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo was demoted to General of the Left.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，零陵王司馬勗薨。

translations.literal: On yihai day Chief Clerk of Lingling Wang Sima Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Chief Clerk of Lingling Wang Sima Xu died.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以前龍驤將軍常珍奇為平北將軍、司州刺史，珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day—former General of Flying Cavalry Chang Zhenqi was made General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si; Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month former General of Flying Cavalry Chang Zhenqi was appointed General Who Levels the North and Inspector of Si; Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji.

sentences.zh: [15]乙巳，右光祿大夫、車騎將軍、護軍將軍王玄謨薨。

translations.literal: [15] On yisi day Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died.
translations.idiomatic: [15] On the yisi day Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died.

translations.literal: [16] Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died: the Three Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Hall edition read "Right Grand Master of the Palace"; the Bureau edition and Wang Xuanmo's biography read "Left Grand Master of the Palace."
translations.idiomatic: [16] Right Grand Master of the Palace, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died: the Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions read "Right Grand Master of the Palace"; the Bureau edition and Wang Xuanmo's biography read "Left Grand Master of the Palace."

sentences.zh: 三月己未，[17]以游擊將軍劉懷珍為東徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei day, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was made Inspector of Eastern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the third month, [17] General Who Attacks in Mobile Warfare Liu Huaizhen was appointed Inspector of Eastern Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁、南秦二州刺史，[18]南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史，[19]交州人李長仁據州叛。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Army Chief Clerk Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin, [18] Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao, [19] and Li Changren of Jiao province seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Army Chief Clerk Liu Lingyi was appointed Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; [18] Administrator of Southern Qiao Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiao; [19] and Li Changren of Jiao province seized the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 妖賊攻廣州，殺刺史羊希，[20]龍驤將軍陳伯紹討平之。

translations.literal: Demon rebels attacked Guang province and killed Inspector Yang Xi; [20] General of Flying Cavalry Chen Bozhao suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Demon rebels attacked Guang province and killed Inspector Yang Xi; [20] General of Flying Cavalry Chen Bozhao put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，復減郡縣田祿之半。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jimao day—the field salaries of commanderies and counties were again reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fourth month of summer the field salaries of commanderies and counties were again reduced by half.

sentences.zh: [21]丙申，東海王褘改封廬江王，[22]山陽王休祐改封晉平王，改晉安郡為晉平郡。

translations.literal: [21] On bingshen day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang, [22] Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping, and Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [21] On the bingshen day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang; [22] Prince Shanyang Wang Xiuyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Jinping; and Jin'an commandery was renamed Jinping commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，芮芮國及河南王並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Rouran state and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the Rouran state and the King of Henan both sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以豫章太守張辯為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Administrator of Yuzhang Zhang Bian was appointed Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，[23]曲赦廣州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi day, [23] partial amnesty was granted to Guang province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fifth month, [23] a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Guang province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以行雍州刺史巴陵王休若行湘州刺史，會稽太守張永為雍州刺史，湘州刺史劉韞為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai day Acting Inspector of Yong Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo acted as Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was made Inspector of Yong; Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Acting Inspector of Yong Prince Baling Wang Xiuruo acted as Inspector of Xiang; Administrator of Kuaiji Zhang Yong was appointed Inspector of Yong; and Inspector of Xiang Liu Yun was made Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，以南康相劉勃為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day—Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eighth month Chancellor of Nankang Liu Bo was appointed Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: [24]辛卯，分青州置東青州，以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史。

translations.literal: [24] On xinmao day Eastern Qing province was established from Qing province; General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qing.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On the xinmao day Eastern Qing province was carved out of Qing province; General Who Assists the State Shen Wenjing was appointed Inspector of Eastern Qing.

sentences.zh: [25]丁酉，安南將軍、江州刺史王景文進號鎮南將軍。

translations.literal: [25] On dingyou day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Stabilizes the South.
translations.idiomatic: [25] On the dingyou day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiang Wang Jingwen was promoted to General Who Stabilizes the South.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，以驃騎長史張悅為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingchen day—Chief Clerk of the General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Zhang Yue was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the ninth month Chief Clerk of the General-in-Chief Who Runs Fast Zhang Yue was appointed Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔曰：「夫愆有小大，憲隨寬猛，故五刑殊用，三典異施。

translations.literal: On wuchen day an edict said: "Offenses have small and great; punishment follows leniency or severity—thus the five punishments differ in use and the three canons differ in application.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict said: "Offenses have small and great; punishment follows leniency or severity—thus the five punishments differ in use and the three canons differ in application.

sentences.zh: 而降辟次網，便暨鉗撻，求之法科，差品滋遠。

translations.literal: Yet when reduced penalties fall under the secondary net, one arrives at shackles and flogging; seeking the legal categories, the gradations grow ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when reduced penalties fall under the secondary net, one arrives at shackles and flogging; measured against the legal code, the gradations grow ever more distant.

sentences.zh: 朕務存欽卹，每有矜貸。

translations.literal: I strive to preserve reverent compassion and always grant clemency.
translations.idiomatic: I strive to preserve reverent compassion and always grant clemency.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪，[26]輕重同之大辟，即事原情，未為詳衷。

translations.literal: Examining the statutes on robbery, [26] light and heavy alike are treated as capital offense—weighing the matter against the facts, this is not a detailed and balanced approach.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the statutes on robbery, [26] light and heavy alike are treated as capital offenses—weighing the matter against the facts, this is not a balanced approach.

sentences.zh: 自今凡竊執官仗，拒戰邏司，或攻剽亭寺，及害吏民者，凡此諸條，悉依舊制。

translations.literal: From now on all who steal official weapons, resist battle and patrol officers, or raid posts and temples and harm officials and people—all such articles shall follow the old statutes.
translations.idiomatic: From now on all who steal official weapons, resist patrol officers in battle, or raid posts and temples and harm officials and people—all such offenses shall follow the old statutes.

sentences.zh: 五人以下相逼奪者，可特賜黥刖，投畀四遠，仍用代殺，方古為優，全命長戶，施同造物。

translations.literal: Those who among five men or fewer forcibly seize from one another may specially be granted tattooing and mutilation, cast out to the four distant regions, and still used in place of execution—compared with antiquity this is lenient, preserving life and lengthening households, a grace equal to creation itself.
translations.idiomatic: Those who among groups of five or fewer forcibly seize from one another may be granted tattooing and mutilation instead of death, cast out to the four distant regions—a leniency compared with antiquity that preserves life and lengthens households, a grace equal to creation itself.

sentences.zh: 庶簡惠之化，有孚羣萌，好生之德，無漏幽品。

translations.literal: Thus may the transformation of simplicity and grace win the trust of the multitude; the virtue of cherishing life may leave no dark rank untouched.
translations.idiomatic: Thus may the transformation of simplicity and grace win the trust of the multitude; the virtue of cherishing life may leave no soul untouched.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，曲赦揚、南徐、兗、豫四州。

translations.literal: " On gengwu day partial amnesty was granted to Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: " On the gengwu day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yang, Southern Xu, Yan, and Yu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the first day guiyou—there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the first of the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 發諸州兵北討。

translations.literal: Troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Troops from the various provinces were mobilized for the northern punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 南康、建安、安成、宣城四郡，昔不同南逆，並不在徵發之例。

translations.literal: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had never joined the southern rebellion and were not included in the levy.
translations.idiomatic: The four commanderies of Nankang, Jian'an, Ancheng, and Xuancheng had never joined the southern rebellion and were exempt from the levy.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，割揚州之義興郡屬南徐州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Yixing commandery in Yang province was detached and placed under Southern Xu province.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Yixing commandery in Yang province was detached and placed under Southern Xu province.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸亥，車駕躬耕藉田。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, guihai day—the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the guihai day of the first month of spring, the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，賜力田爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire; those who worked the fields diligently were granted one step in noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire, and diligent farmers were granted one step in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，分豫州、揚州立南豫州，以太尉廬江王褘為車騎將軍，開府儀同三司、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen day—Southern Yu province was established from Yu and Yang provinces; Grand Minister of Works Prince Hui of Lujiang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with Staff equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Southern Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the second month Southern Yu province was carved out of Yu and Yang provinces; Grand Minister of Works Prince Hui of Lujiang was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Southern Yu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，於南豫州立南義陽郡。

translations.literal: Third month, yimao day—Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the third month Southern Yiyang commandery was established within Southern Yu province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕幸中堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the imperial carriage visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the Emperor visited the Central Hall to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jisi day the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the King of Henan sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，割雍州隨郡屬郢州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinwei day—Suicheng in Yong province was detached and placed under Ying province.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fourth month of summer Suicheng in Yong province was detached and placed under Ying province.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，割豫州義陽郡屬郢州，郢州西陽郡屬豫州。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Yiyang commandery in Yu province was detached and placed under Ying province; Xiyang commandery in Ying province was placed under Yu province.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yiyang commandery in Yu province was detached and placed under Ying province, and Xiyang commandery in Ying province was placed under Yu province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以寧朔將軍崔公烈為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Ning Shuo General Cui Gonglie was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Ning Shuo General Cui Gonglie was appointed Inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，新除給事黃門侍郎杜幼文為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, newly appointed Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day newly appointed Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Du Youwen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinwei day: Prince Xiuyou of Jinping's son Xuanyao was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the sixth month Prince Xiuyou of Jinping's son Xuanyao was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: [27]壬申，以安西將軍、郢州刺史蔡興宗為鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: [27] On renshen day, General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: [27] On the renshen day General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Ying Cai Xingzong was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以左衞將軍沈攸之為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Left Guard General Shen Youzhi was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Left Guard General Shen Youzhi was appointed Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以軍興已來，百官斷俸，並給生食。

translations.literal: Because military campaigns had been underway, officials' salaries were suspended and raw provisions were issued instead.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm had been at war, officials' salaries were cut off and raw provisions were issued in their place.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，車騎將軍、南豫州刺史廬江王褘免官爵。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Prince Hui of Lujiang was stripped of rank and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou Prince Hui of Lujiang was deprived of his offices and title.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左將軍、行湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征南將軍、湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Left General and Acting Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Left General and Acting Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷南豫州。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Southern Yuzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Southern Yuzhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以新除給事黃門侍郎劉亮為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, newly appointed Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Liu Liang was made Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day newly appointed Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Liu Liang was appointed Inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，以輔國將軍王亮為徐州刺史，東莞太守陳伯紹為交州刺史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiyou day: Fu Guo General Wang Liang was made Inspector of Xuzhou; Dongguan Administrator Chen Bozhao was made Inspector of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiyou day, Fu Guo General Wang Liang was appointed Inspector of Xuzhou and Dongguan Administrator Chen Bozhao was appointed Inspector of Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以山陽太守李靈謙為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Shanyang Administrator Li Lingqian was made Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Shanyang Administrator Li Lingqian was appointed Inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改輔國將軍為輔師將軍。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the title Fu Guo General was changed to Fu Shi General.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the title Fu Guo General was changed to Fu Shi General.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，以右將軍行豫州刺史劉勔為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jichou day: Acting Right General and Inspector of Yuzhou Liu Mian was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jichou day, Acting Right General and Inspector of Yuzhou Liu Mian was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以海陵太守劉崇智為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Hailing Administrator Liu Chongzhi was made Inspector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Hailing Administrator Liu Chongzhi was appointed Inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，立長沙王纂子延之為始平王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiayin day: Prince Zuan of Changsha's son Yanzhi was established as Prince of Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiayin day, Prince Zuan of Changsha's son Yanzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Shiping.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中領軍王琨遷職。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Colonel of the Garrison Wang Kun was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Colonel of the Garrison Wang Kun was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔曰：「夫箕、潁之操，振古所貴，沖素之風，哲王攸重。

translations.literal: On jiwei day an edict said: "The integrity of men of Ji and Ying has been prized since antiquity; the spirit of plain simplicity has ever been held dear by wise kings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day an edict said: "The integrity of the recluses of Ji and Ying has been prized since antiquity, and the spirit of plain simplicity has ever been cherished by wise kings.

sentences.zh: 朕屬橫流之會，接難晦之辰，龕暴剪亂，日不暇給。

translations.literal: I have come upon a time of raging currents and an age of hardship and obscurity; suppressing violence and cutting down disorder leave me not a moment's rest.
translations.idiomatic: I have inherited an age of raging currents and gathering darkness; suppressing the violent and cutting down rebellion leave me not a moment's rest.

sentences.zh: 今雖關、隴猶靄，區縣澄氛，偃武修文，於是乎在。

translations.literal: Though Guan and Long still lie shrouded in mist and clarity has not yet settled over every district and county, to sheathe the sword and cultivate letters—this is the task now before us.
translations.idiomatic: Though Guan and Long still lie shrouded in mist and peace has not yet settled over every district and county, the time has come to sheathe the sword and cultivate letters.

sentences.zh: 思崇廉耻，用靜馳薄，固已物色載懷，寢興竚歎。

translations.literal: Thinking to exalt integrity and shame and to still the restless pursuit of gain, I have long kept such men in mind, sighing whether waking or at rest.
translations.idiomatic: Wishing to exalt integrity and shame and to still the restless pursuit of gain, I have long kept such men in mind, sighing whether waking or at rest.

sentences.zh: 其有貞栖隱約，息事衡樊，[28]鑿坏遺榮，負釣辭聘，志恬江海，行高塵俗者，在所精加搜括，時以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who dwell in steadfast seclusion, live quietly in their orchards and gardens, [28] pierce the wall and renounce glory, fish by the river and decline summons—whose hearts are at peace as the rivers and seas, whose conduct towers above the vulgar—let the regions carefully seek them out and promptly bring their names to report.
translations.idiomatic: Those who dwell in steadfast seclusion, live quietly in their orchards and gardens, [28] pierce the wall and renounce glory, fish by the river and decline summons—whose hearts are at peace as the rivers and seas and whose conduct towers above the vulgar—let every region carefully seek them out and promptly report their names.

sentences.zh: 將賁園矜德，茂昭厥禮。

translations.literal: We shall honor gardens and cherish virtue, and richly display the ceremonies befitting them.
translations.idiomatic: We shall honor their gardens and cherish their virtue, and richly display the ceremonies befitting them.

sentences.zh: 羣司各舉所知，以時授爵。

translations.literal: Each office shall recommend those it knows and confer rank upon them in due season.
translations.idiomatic: Each office shall recommend those it knows and confer rank upon them in due season.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以新除平西將軍、豫州刺史劉勔為中領軍。

translations.literal: " On yichou day, newly appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou Liu Mian was made Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: " On the yichou day newly appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yuzhou Liu Mian was appointed Colonel of the Garrison.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: on dingmao, the first day of the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, the first day of the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei day: the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingwei day, the Northern Wei sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史晉平王休祐以本號為南徐州刺史，征南將軍、湘州刺史巴陵王休若為征西將軍、荊州刺史，輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史，[29]義陽太守呂安國為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, wuzi day: General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Xiuyou of Jinping retained his title and was made Inspector of Southern Xuzhou; General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Fu Shi General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yanzhou; [29] Yiyang Administrator Lu Anguo was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuzi day, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jingzhou Prince Xiuyou of Jinping retained his title and was reassigned as Inspector of Southern Xuzhou; General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou; Fu Shi General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yanzhou; [29] and Yiyang Administrator Lu Anguo was appointed Inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，司徒建安王休仁解揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuxu day: Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an resigned as Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an stepped down as Inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，以征北大將軍、南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監、中軍將軍、揚州刺史，[30]吳興太守建平王景素為湘州刺史，輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yangzhou; [30] Wu Xing Administrator Prince Jingsu of Pingping was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; Fu Shi General Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed Supervisor of the Secretariat, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yangzhou; [30] Wu Xing Administrator Prince Jingsu of Pingping was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; and Fu Shi General Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: [31]庚申，分荊、益州五郡置三巴校尉。

translations.literal: [31] On gengshen day, five commanderies of Jing and Yi were split off to establish the Commandant of Sanba.
translations.idiomatic: [31] On the gengshen day five commanderies of Jing and Yi were separated to establish the Commandant of Sanba.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月乙亥，初制間二年一祭南郊，間一年一祭明堂。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, yihai day: for the first time it was decreed that the Southern Suburb be sacrificed to once every two years and the Bright Hall once every year.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the yihai day of the first month of spring, it was first decreed that sacrifices at the Southern Suburb occur once every two years and at the Bright Hall once every year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，司徒建安王休仁為太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin day: Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was made Grand Marshal and continued as Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renyin day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an was appointed Grand Marshal while continuing as Minister.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，皇太子納妃。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the crown prince received his consort.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day the crown prince took his consort.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 巧注從軍，不在赦例。

translations.literal: Those who had followed the army through forced conscription were excluded from the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Those conscripted through forced levies for military service were excluded from the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 班賜各有差。

translations.literal: Distributions of gifts were made according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，中護軍劉襲卒。

translations.literal: Third month, yihai day: General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yihai day, General Who Protects the Army Liu Xi died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太子詹事張永為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Zhang Yong was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，立第六皇子燮為晉熙王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guihai day: the sixth prince, Xie, was established as Prince of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guihai day, the sixth prince, Xie, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，以前軍將軍陳胤宗為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou day: former Van General Chen Yinzong was made Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingchou day, former Van General Chen Yinzong was appointed Inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以冠軍將軍吐谷渾拾虔為平西將軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Champion General Tuyuhun Shiqian was made General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Champion General Tuyuhun Shiqian was appointed General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 戊子，奉朝請孔玉為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Court Gentleman Kong Yu was made Inspector of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Court Gentleman Kong Yu was appointed Inspector of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，以第五皇子智井繼東平沖王休倩。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jihai day: the fifth prince, Zhijing, succeeded Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiuqian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jihai day, the fifth prince, Zhijing, succeeded Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiuqian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以侍中劉韞為撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，前將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號鎮軍將軍，揚州刺史桂陽王休範為征南大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou; former Van General and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Stabilizes the Army; Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Yun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yongzhou; former Van General and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Stabilizes the Army; and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史王景文為尚書左僕射、揚州刺史，尚書僕射袁粲為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On guimao day, General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Wang Jingwen was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yangzhou; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Wang Jingwen was appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yangzhou, and Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 己未，改臨賀郡為臨慶郡，追改東平王休倩為臨慶沖王。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiuqian, was posthumously renamed Prince Chong of Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Linhe commandery was renamed Linqing commandery, and Prince Chong of Dongping, Xiuqian, was posthumously renamed Prince Chong of Linqing.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，第五皇子智井薨。

translations.literal: Seventh month, bingxu day: the fifth prince, Zhijing, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the bingxu day, the fifth prince, Zhijing, died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，中領軍劉勔加平北將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yichou day: Colonel of the Garrison Liu Mian was additionally made General Who Levels the North.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day, Colonel of the Garrison Liu Mian was additionally appointed General Who Levels the North.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立總明觀，徵學士以充之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars were summoned to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day the Zongming Observatory was established and scholars were summoned to staff it.

sentences.zh: 置東觀祭酒。

translations.literal: A Director of the Eastern Pavilion was established.
translations.idiomatic: The post of Director of the Eastern Pavilion was established.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以第八皇子智渙繼臨慶沖王休倩。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the eighth prince, Zhihuan, succeeded Prince Chong of Linqing, Xiuqian.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the eighth prince, Zhihuan, succeeded Prince Chong of Linqing, Xiuqian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，立第九皇子贊為武陵王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinmao day: the ninth prince, Zan, was established as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinmao day, the ninth prince, Zan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以前右軍馬詵為北雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On yisi day, former Right General Ma Shen was made Inspector of Northern Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day former Right General Ma Shen was appointed Inspector of Northern Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕幸東堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Hall to hear legal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the Emperor visited the Eastern Hall to hear legal cases.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jisi day: the kingdom of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jisi day, the kingdom of Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，以邊難未息，制父母陷異域，悉使婚宦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guisi day: because border troubles had not ceased, it was decreed that all whose parents had fallen into foreign lands should be permitted to marry and take office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guisi day, because border warfare had not ended, it was decreed that all whose parents were held in foreign lands should be permitted to marry and enter office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以始興郡為宋安郡。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Shixing commandery was renamed Song'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，護軍將軍張永遷職。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day General Who Protects the Army Zhang Yong was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，索虜遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, xinyou day: the Northern Wei sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, the Northern Wei sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，芮芮國遣使奉獻。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，減天下死罪一等，凡敕繫悉遣之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou day: capital punishment throughout the empire was reduced by one degree, and all held under amnesty orders were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinchou day, capital punishment throughout the empire was reduced by one degree, and all prisoners held under amnesty orders were released.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，於南兗州置新平郡。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xinping commandery was established within Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金紫光祿大夫張永領護軍。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Zhang Yong additionally served as Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Zhang Yong additionally served as Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，司徒建安王休仁有罪，自殺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuwu day: Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, found guilty of a crime, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuwu day, Minister Prince Xiuren of Jian'an, found guilty of a crime, took his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以寧朔長史孫超之為廣州刺史，尚書左僕射、揚州刺史王景文以刺史領中書監。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Chief Clerk of Ning Shuo Sun Chaozhi was made Inspector of Guangzhou; Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yangzhou Wang Jingwen held the inspectorate while additionally serving as Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Chief Clerk of Ning Shuo Sun Chaozhi was appointed Inspector of Guangzhou, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yangzhou Wang Jingwen held his inspectorate while additionally serving as Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以尚書右僕射袁粲為尚書令，新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was made Director of the Masters of Writing; newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Can was promoted to Director of the Masters of Writing, and newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: [32]辛未，監吳郡王僧虔行湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [32] On xinwei day, Supervisor Prince Sengqian of Wu was made Acting Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: [32] On the xinwei day Supervisor Prince Sengqian of Wu was appointed Acting Inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，追免晉平王休祐為庶人。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Prince Xiuyou of Jinping was posthumously stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以征南大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範為驃騎大將軍、南徐州刺史，征北大將軍巴陵王休若為車騎大將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingyou day: General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou; General Who Pacifies the North Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingyou day, General Who Punishes the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, and General Who Pacifies the North Prince Xiuruo of Baling was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，罷散騎奏舉郎。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, dingsi day: the office of Attendant Censor for Memorial Presentation was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingsi day, the office of Attendant Censor for Memorial Presentation was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，新除車騎大將軍、江州刺史巴陵王休若薨，桂陽王休範以新除驃騎大將軍，還為江州。

translations.literal: On yichou day, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling died; Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, returned to Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiuruo of Baling died, and Prince Xiufan of Guiyang, newly appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, returned to Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以第三皇子準為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the third prince, Zhun, was made General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the third prince, Zhun, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事劉秉為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was made Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Liu Bing was appointed Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以寧朔將軍沈懷明為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Ning Shuo General Shen Huaiming was made Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Ning Shuo General Shen Huaiming was appointed Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，於冀州置西海郡。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Xihai commandery was established within Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Xihai commandery was established within Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，第八皇子躋繼江夏文獻王義恭。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuzi day: the eighth prince, Ji, succeeded Prince Wenxian of Jiangxia, Yigong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuzi day, the eighth prince, Ji, succeeded Prince Wenxian of Jiangxia, Yigong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以疾愈大赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, because the Emperor had recovered from illness, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, because the Emperor had recovered from illness, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史劉崇智加青州刺史。

translations.literal: Inspector of Jizhou Liu Chongzhi was additionally made Inspector of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Jizhou Liu Chongzhi was additionally appointed Inspector of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立第三皇子準為安成王。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the third prince, Zhun, was established as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the third prince, Zhun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以越騎校尉周寧民為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinwei day: Commandant of Yueqi Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was made Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinwei day, Commandant of Yueqi Cavalry Zhou Ningmin was appointed Inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午，[33]百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day: [33] the kingdom of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the wuwu day, [33] the kingdom of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，分豫州、南兗州立南豫州，以歷陽太守王玄載為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou day: Southern Yuzhou was established by splitting off parts of Yuzhou and Southern Yanzhou; Liyang Administrator Wang Xuanzai was made Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingyou day, Southern Yuzhou was established by separating parts of Yuzhou and Southern Yanzhou, and Liyang Administrator Wang Xuanzai was appointed Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 泰豫元年春正月甲寅朔，上有疾不朝會。

translations.literal: First year of Taiyu, spring, first month, jiayin, first day of new moon: because of illness the Emperor did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyu, on jiayin, the first day of the first month of spring, the Emperor did not hold court audience because of illness.

sentences.zh: 以疾患未痊，故改元。

translations.literal: Because his illness had not yet healed, the reign era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Because his illness had not yet healed, the reign era was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜孤老貧疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: The solitary elderly, the poor, and the sick were granted grain and cloth according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The solitary elderly, the poor, and the sick were granted grain and cloth in amounts according to need.

sentences.zh: 戊午，皇太子會萬國於東宮，并受貢計。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the crown prince received the tribute missions of all states at the Eastern Palace and accepted their tribute accounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day the crown prince received the tribute missions of all states at the Eastern Palace and accepted their tribute accounts.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，以給事黃門侍郎王瞻為司州刺史。

translations.literal: Second month, xinchou day: Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Wang Zhan was made Inspector of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinchou day, Gentleman Cadet of the Yellow Gate Wang Zhan was appointed Inspector of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，林邑國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: Third month, guichou, first day of new moon: the kingdom of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, the first day of the new moon, the kingdom of Linyi sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 己未，中書監、揚州刺史王景文卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Supervisor of the Secretariat and Inspector of Yangzhou Wang Jingwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Supervisor of the Secretariat and Inspector of Yangzhou Wang Jingwen died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，以撫軍司馬蔡那為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao day: Marshal of the Pacifying Army Cai Na was made Inspector of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinmao day, Marshal of the Pacifying Army Cai Na was appointed Inspector of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Right Guard General Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Right Guard General Zhang Xingshi was appointed Inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: [34]己亥，上大漸。

translations.literal: [34] On jihai day, the Emperor's illness grew critical.
translations.idiomatic: [34] On the jihai day the Emperor's illness grew critical.

sentences.zh: 驃騎大將軍、江州刺史桂陽王休範進位司空，尚書右僕射褚淵為護軍將軍，中領軍劉勔加尚書右僕射，鎮東將軍蔡興宗為征西將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，鎮軍將軍、郢州刺史沈攸之進號安西將軍。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was made General Who Protects the Army; Colonel of the Garrison Liu Mian was additionally made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Pacifies the East Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the West with Staff equal to Three Divisions and Inspector of Jingzhou; General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was promoted to Minister of Works; Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Yuan was appointed General Who Protects the Army; Colonel of the Garrison Liu Mian was additionally made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; General Who Pacifies the East Cai Xingzong was made General Who Pacifies the West with protocol equal to a three-division office and Inspector of Jingzhou; and General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Ying Shen Youzhi was promoted to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨御億兆，仍屬戎寇，雖每存弘化，而惠弗覃遠，軍國凋弊，刑訟未息。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since I began to rule the myriad people, I have still been beset by armed enemies; though I have constantly sought broad reform, benevolence has not reached far, the state and army are exhausted, and lawsuits have not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Since I began to rule the myriad people, armed enemies have still beset the realm; though I have constantly sought broad reform, benevolence has not reached far, the state and army are exhausted, and lawsuits have not ceased.

sentences.zh: 今大漸維危，載深矜歎。

translations.literal: Now my illness is grave and perilous, and my sighs of compassion run deep.
translations.idiomatic: Now my illness is grave and perilous, and my sighs of compassion run deep.

sentences.zh: 可緩徭優調，去繁就約。

translations.literal: Corvée and levies may be eased and burdens lightened; remove the elaborate and keep the essential.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée and levies may be eased and burdens lightened; remove the elaborate and keep the essential.

sentences.zh: 因改之宜，詳有簡衷。

translations.literal: In accordance with what the change requires, examine matters with careful judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In accordance with what this change requires, examine matters with careful judgment.

sentences.zh: 務以愛民為先，以宣朕遺意。

translations.literal: Make cherishing the people the first priority, to proclaim my final intent.
translations.idiomatic: Make cherishing the people the first priority, to proclaim my final intent.

sentences.zh: 」袁粲、褚淵、劉勔、蔡興宗、沈攸之同被顧命。

translations.literal: " Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the imperial testament.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuan Can, Chu Yuan, Liu Mian, Cai Xingzong, and Shen Youzhi were all entrusted with the imperial testament.

sentences.zh: 是日，上崩于景福殿，時年三十四。

translations.literal: That same day the Emperor died in Jingfu Hall at the age of thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Emperor died in Jingfu Hall at the age of thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，葬臨沂縣莫府山高寧陵。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuyin day: he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, he was buried at Gaoning Mausoleum on Mount Mofu in Linyi county.

sentences.zh: 帝少而和令，風姿端雅。

translations.literal: The Emperor from youth was gentle and amiable, with dignified bearing and refined grace.
translations.idiomatic: From youth the Emperor was gentle and amiable, with dignified bearing and refined grace.

sentences.zh: 早失所生，養於太后宮內。

translations.literal: He lost his birth mother early and was raised within the Empress Dowager's palace.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his birth mother early and was raised in the Empress Dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 大明世，諸弟多被猜忌，唯上見親，常侍路太后醫藥。

translations.literal: In the Daming era many of the princes were suspected, but the Emperor alone was treated with affection; he often attended Empress Dowager Lu in administering medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daming era many of the princes fell under suspicion, but the Emperor alone was treated with affection and often attended Empress Dowager Lu in administering medicine.

sentences.zh: 好讀書，愛文義，在藩時，撰江左以來文章志，又續衞瓘所注論語二卷，行於世。

translations.literal: He loved reading and cherished literary meaning; while still a prince he compiled a record of writings since the Eastern Jin, and also continued Wei Guan's commentary on the Analects in two scrolls, which circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He loved reading and cherished literary pursuits; while still a prince he compiled a record of writings since the Eastern Jin, and also continued Wei Guan's commentary on the Analects in two scrolls, which circulated in the world.

sentences.zh: 及即大位，四方反叛，以寬仁待物，諸軍帥有父兄子弟同逆者，並授以禁兵，委任不易，故眾為之用，莫不盡力。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, rebellions broke out on every side; he treated men with generous forbearance. Commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebels were still entrusted with palace guard troops, and his appointments did not change—so the armies served him and none failed to exert themselves to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne, rebellions broke out on every side, yet he treated men with generous forbearance. Commanders whose fathers, brothers, or sons had joined the rebels were still entrusted with palace guard troops, and his appointments did not waver—so the armies served him willingly and none failed to exert themselves to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 平定天下，逆黨多被全，其有才能者，並見授用，有如舊臣。

translations.literal: When the realm was pacified, many of the rebel party were spared; those with talent were all given employment, as though they had been old ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was pacified, many rebels were spared; those with talent were all given office, as though they had been old ministers.

sentences.zh: 才學之士，多蒙引進，參侍文籍，應對左右。

translations.literal: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward to attend upon literary records and answer at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Men of talent and learning were often brought forward to attend upon literary records and answer at his side.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易，[35]常自臨聽。

translations.literal: In the Hanlin Garden at Hanfang Hall he lectured on the Book of Changes, [35] and he often listened in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hanlin Garden at Hanfang Hall he lectured on the Book of Changes, [35] and he often listened in person.

sentences.zh: 末年好鬼神，多忌諱，言語文書，有禍敗凶喪及疑似之言應回避者，數百千品，有犯必加罪戮。

translations.literal: In his later years he favored spirits and omens and was full of taboos; in speech and writing there were hundreds and thousands of words of disaster, ruin, mourning, and suspected ill omen that had to be avoided—any violation was punished by death.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he favored spirits and omens and was full of taboos; in speech and writing there were hundreds and thousands of words of disaster, ruin, mourning, and suspected ill omen that had to be avoided—any violation was punished by death.

sentences.zh: 改「騧」為馬邊瓜，[36]亦以「騧」字似「禍」字故也。

translations.literal: He changed the character for "piebald horse" to "horse beside melon," [36] because the character for "piebald horse" also resembled the character for "disaster."
translations.idiomatic: He changed the character for "piebald horse" to "horse beside melon," [36] because the character for "piebald horse" also resembled the character for "disaster."

sentences.zh: 以南苑借張永，云「且給三百年，期訖更啟」。

translations.literal: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, "For now let it be given for three hundred years; when the term ends, report again."
translations.idiomatic: He lent the Southern Park to Zhang Yong, saying, "For now let it be given for three hundred years; when the term ends, report again."

sentences.zh: 其事類皆如此。

translations.literal: His affairs were all of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: His affairs were all of this sort.

sentences.zh: 宣陽門，民間謂之白門，上以白門之名不祥，甚諱之。

translations.literal: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; because the name White Gate was inauspicious, the Emperor greatly tabooed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanyang Gate was popularly called the White Gate; because the name White Gate was inauspicious, the Emperor strictly tabooed it.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞江謐嘗誤犯，上變色曰：「白汝家門！

translations.literal: Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally violated the taboo; the Emperor changed color and said, "White is your family's gate!
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing Jiang Mi once accidentally violated the taboo; the Emperor flushed with anger and said, "White is your family's gate!

sentences.zh: 」謐稽顙謝，久之方釋。

translations.literal: " Mi kowtowed in apology, and only after a long while was he released.
translations.idiomatic: " Mi kowtowed in apology, and only after a long while was he released.

sentences.zh: 太后停屍漆牀先出東宮，上嘗幸宮，見之怒甚，免中庶子官，職局以之坐者數十人。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager's corpse was first carried out of the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the Emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious; he dismissed the Palace Attendant to the Heir Apparent, and several dozen officials in that bureau were punished on that account.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager's corpse was first carried out of the Eastern Palace on a lacquered couch, the Emperor once visited the palace, saw it, and was furious; he dismissed the Palace Attendant to the Heir Apparent, and several dozen officials in that bureau were punished on that account.

sentences.zh: [37]內外常慮犯觸，人不自保。

translations.literal: [37] Within and without the palace all constantly feared giving offense; no one could feel secure.
translations.idiomatic: [37] Within and without the palace all constantly feared giving offense; no one could feel secure.

sentences.zh: 宮內禁忌尤甚，移牀治壁，必先祭土神，使文士為文詞祝策，如大祭饗。

translations.literal: Taboos within the palace were especially severe: to move a bed or repair a wall, one first had to sacrifice to the earth god and have a literary man compose a prayer text and sacrificial address, as at a great offering.
translations.idiomatic: Taboos within the palace were especially severe: to move a bed or repair a wall, one first had to sacrifice to the earth god and have a literary man compose a prayer text and sacrificial address, as at a great offering.

sentences.zh: 泰始、泰豫之際，更忍虐好殺，左右失旨忤意，往往有斮刳斷截者。

translations.literal: In the Taishi and Taiyu eras he became ever more cruel and fond of killing; attendants who missed his intent or displeased him were often hacked, flayed, or cut apart.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taishi and Taiyu eras he became ever more cruel and fond of killing; attendants who missed his intent or displeased him were often hacked, flayed, or cut apart.

sentences.zh: 時經略淮、泗，軍旅不息，荒弊積久，府藏空竭。

translations.literal: At the time campaigns along the Huai and Si never ceased; after long years of devastation the treasury was empty.
translations.idiomatic: At the time campaigns along the Huai and Si never ceased; after long years of devastation the treasury was empty.

sentences.zh: 內外百官，並日料祿俸；

translations.literal: Officials within and without the palace all received daily measured stipends;
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without the palace all received daily measured stipends;

sentences.zh: [38]而上奢費過度，務為彫侈。

translations.literal: [38] yet the Emperor's extravagance exceeded all bounds, and he pursued carved ornament.
translations.idiomatic: [38] yet the Emperor's extravagance exceeded all bounds, and he pursued carved ornament.

sentences.zh: 每所造制，必為正御三十副，御次、副又各三十，須一物輒造九十枚，天下騷然，民不堪命。

translations.literal: For every object he ordered made, he required thirty sets for the primary imperial use, thirty for secondary imperial use, and thirty for each further rank—ninety pieces for a single item—and the realm was in uproar; the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: For every object he ordered made, he required thirty sets for the primary imperial use, thirty for secondary imperial use, and thirty for each further rank—ninety pieces for a single item—and the realm was in uproar; the people could not bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 其餘事迹，列見眾篇。

translations.literal: His other deeds are set forth in detail in the various chapters.
translations.idiomatic: His other deeds are set forth in detail in the various chapters.

sentences.zh: [39]親近讒慝，剪落皇枝，宋氏之業，自此衰矣。

translations.literal: [39] Through favor shown to slanderers and the wicked, he pruned away the imperial branches, and from this the house of Song began to decline.
translations.idiomatic: [39] Through favor shown to slanderers and the wicked, he pruned away the imperial branches, and from this the house of Song began to decline.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：聖人立法垂制，所以必稱先王，蓋由遺訓餘風，足以貽之來世也。

translations.literal: The historian says: When the sage establishes law and leaves institutions behind, he must invoke the former kings, because their surviving instructions and lingering customs are enough to bequeath to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: When the sage establishes law and leaves institutions behind, he must invoke the former kings, because their surviving instructions and lingering customs are enough to bequeath to later generations.

sentences.zh: 太祖負扆南面，實有君人之懿焉，經國之義雖弘，而隆家之道不足。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor, facing south with the imperial screen, truly possessed the excellence of one who rules men; though his principles of governing the state were broad, his way of exalting the family was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor, facing south with the imperial screen, truly possessed the excellence of one who rules men; though his principles of governing the state were broad, his way of exalting the family was insufficient.

sentences.zh: 彭城王照不窺古，本無卓爾之資，[40]徒見昆弟之義，未識君臣之禮，冀以此家情，行之國道，主猜而猶犯，恩薄而未悟，致以呵訓之微行，遂成滅親之大禍。

translations.literal: Prince Pengcheng, Zhao, did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding talent; [40] he saw only the righteousness among brothers and did not understand the rites between ruler and minister. He hoped to carry this family sentiment into the way of the state; the ruler was suspicious yet he still overstepped, favor was thin yet he still did not awaken—so from a trifling act of reproof there came the great calamity of destroying kin.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pengcheng, Zhao, did not look to antiquity and by nature lacked outstanding talent; [40] he saw only the righteousness among brothers and did not understand the rites between ruler and minister. He hoped to carry this family sentiment into the way of the state; the ruler was suspicious yet he still overstepped, favor was thin yet he still did not awaken—so from a trifling act of reproof there came the great calamity of destroying kin.

sentences.zh: 開端樹隙，垂之後人。

translations.literal: He opened the breach and planted the rift, and bequeathed it to those who came after.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the breach and planted the rift, and bequeathed it to those who came after.

sentences.zh: 雖天倫之重，義殊凡戚，而中人以下，情由恩變。

translations.literal: Though the weight of Heaven's kin differs from ordinary affection, for men of middling virtue and below, feeling follows favor.
translations.idiomatic: Though the weight of Heaven's kin differs from ordinary affection, for men of middling virtue and below, feeling follows favor.

sentences.zh: 至於易衣而出，分苦而食，與夫別宮異門，形疎事隔者，宜有降矣。

translations.literal: As for changing clothes before going out, sharing hardship in eating, as against dwelling in separate palaces behind different gates with form estranged and affairs divided—there ought to be a descent.
translations.idiomatic: As for changing clothes before going out and sharing hardship in eating, as against dwelling in separate palaces behind different gates with form estranged and affairs divided—there ought to be a descent.

sentences.zh: 太宗因易隙之情，據已行之典，剪落洪枝，願不待慮。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming seized upon the sentiment opened by that breach, relied on precedents already in practice, and pruned away the great branches without waiting for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming seized upon the sentiment opened by that breach, relied on precedents already in practice, and pruned away the great branches without waiting for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 既而本根無庇，幼主孤立，神器以勢弱傾移，靈命隨樂推回改。

translations.literal: Soon the root had no shelter, the young ruler stood alone, the sacred vessel shifted because power was weak, and the luminous mandate turned with the tide of acclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the root had no shelter, the young ruler stood alone, the sacred vessel shifted because power was weak, and the luminous mandate turned with the tide of acclamation.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋履霜有漸，堅冰自至，所從來遠也。

translations.literal: This is like frost appearing by degrees and solid ice arriving of itself—the source lies far back.
translations.idiomatic: This is like frost appearing by degrees and solid ice arriving of itself—the source lies far back.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Textual collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual collation notes

sentences.zh: 南徐州刺史永嘉王子仁為中軍將軍 各本並脫「南」字，據永嘉王子仁傳補。

translations.literal: Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army: all editions omit the character "Southern"; supplied from the biography of Prince Ziren of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Ziren of Yongjia was made General of the Center Army: all editions omit the character "Southern"; supplied from the biography of Prince Ziren of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 癸酉 各本並作「壬午」，據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Guiyou day: all editions read renwu; changed according to the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyou day: all editions read renwu; changed according to the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚申朔，十三日壬申，十六日乙亥。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on gengshen; the thirteenth day is renshen and the sixteenth day is yihai.
translations.idiomatic: According to the calendar, that month began on gengshen; the thirteenth day is renshen and the sixteenth day is yihai.

sentences.zh: 宋書本紀此詔在十三日壬申後，十六日乙亥前，則作壬午誤，作癸酉是。

translations.literal: In the annals of the Song shu this edict falls after the thirteenth day, renshen, and before the sixteenth day, yihai; thus renwu is wrong and guiyou is correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the annals of the Song shu this edict falls after the thirteenth day, renshen, and before the sixteenth day, yihai; thus renwu is wrong and guiyou is correct.

sentences.zh: 詳悉條奏 「詳」各本並作「許」，據元龜二一三改。

translations.literal: Report in full detail: in all editions "detail" reads "permit"; changed according to Yuan Gui 213.
translations.idiomatic: Report in full detail: in all editions "detail" reads "permit"; changed according to Yuan Gui 213.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍劉勔前鋒西討 「西討」各本作「南討」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Fu Guo General Liu Mian, vanguard, campaign west: in all editions "west" reads "south"; changed according to the Nan shi.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Guo General Liu Mian, vanguard, campaign west: in all editions "west" reads "south"; changed according to the Nan shi.

sentences.zh: 按劉勔時攻壽陽，當云「西討」。

translations.literal: According to the circumstances, Liu Mian was then attacking Shouyang and should read "campaign west."
translations.idiomatic: According to the circumstances, Liu Mian was then attacking Shouyang and should read "campaign west."

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍殷孝祖攻赭圻死之以輔國將軍沈攸之代為南討前鋒 「撫軍」下脫文十三字，據南史補。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhuzhi and died; Fu Guo General Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign: below "Pacifying Army" thirteen characters are missing; supplied from the Nan shi.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army Yin Xiaozu attacked Zhuzhi and died; Fu Guo General Shen Youzhi replaced him as vanguard of the southern campaign: below "Pacifying Army" thirteen characters are missing; supplied from the Nan shi.

sentences.zh: 時殷孝祖為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: At the time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yin Xiaozu was General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 史事參沈攸之傳、殷孝祖傳。

translations.literal: The historical events may be compared with the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.
translations.idiomatic: The historical events may be compared with the biographies of Shen Youzhi and Yin Xiaozu.

sentences.zh: 葬崇憲皇太后於修寧陵 「修」各本並譌「攸」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: Burial of Empress Dowager Chongxian at Xiuning Mausoleum: in all editions "Xiuning" is written wrongly as "Youning"; changed according to the Nan shi and Zizhi tongjian.
translations.idiomatic: Burial of Empress Dowager Chongxian at Xiuning Mausoleum: in all editions "Xiuning" is written wrongly as "Youning"; changed according to the Nan shi and Zizhi tongjian.

sentences.zh: 通鑑胡三省注曰：「修寧陵，在孝武陵東南。」

translations.literal: Hu Sanxing's note in the Zizhi tongjian says: "Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Emperor Xiaowu's mausoleum."
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sanxing's note in the Zizhi tongjian says: "Xiuning Mausoleum lies southeast of Emperor Xiaowu's mausoleum."

sentences.zh: 以建安王休仁世子伯融為豫州刺史 「豫州」建安王休仁傳作「南豫州」。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was made Inspector of Yuzhou: in the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an the post reads Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was made Inspector of Yuzhou: in the biography of Prince Xiuren of Jian'an the post reads Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 以吳郡太守顧覬之為湘州刺史 「覬」各本並作「顗」，據覬之傳改。
