translations.literal: Wu commandery Administrator Gu Zhi was made Inspector of Xiangzhou: in all editions "Zhi" is written as "Yi"; changed according to the biography of Gu Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu commandery Administrator Gu Zhi was made Inspector of Xiangzhou: in all editions "Zhi" is written as "Yi"; changed according to the biography of Gu Zhi.

sentences.zh: 曲赦揚南徐二州 各本並脫「南」字，據建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu: all editions omit the character "Southern"; supplied from the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Partial amnesty for Yang and Southern Xu: all editions omit the character "Southern"; supplied from the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 出獻納貢 「出」元龜一九八作「來」。

translations.literal: Presented tribute and submitted accounts: in Yuan Gui 198 "presented" reads "came."
translations.idiomatic: Presented tribute and submitted accounts: in Yuan Gui 198 "presented" reads "came."

sentences.zh: 夫秉機詢政 「秉」各本並作「矢」，據元龜二一二改。

translations.literal: Holding the helm and inquiring into governance: in all editions "holding" reads "arrow"; changed according to Yuan Gui 212.
translations.idiomatic: Holding the helm and inquiring into governance: in all editions "holding" reads "arrow"; changed according to Yuan Gui 212.

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉靈遺」各本並作「劉靈道」。

translations.literal: Fu Guo General Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: in all editions "Liu Lingyi" reads "Liu Lingdao."
translations.idiomatic: Fu Guo General Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: in all editions "Liu Lingyi" reads "Liu Lingdao."

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作『劉靈遺』，鄧琬傳可證。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "It should read Liu Lingyi; the biography of Deng Wan proves it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "It should read Liu Lingyi; the biography of Deng Wan proves it.

sentences.zh: 下四年亦作『劉靈遺』。

translations.literal: In the fourth year below it also reads Liu Lingyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year below it also reads Liu Lingyi.

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " According to Zhang, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 以游擊將軍垣閎為益州刺史 「垣閎」各本並作「垣閬」。

translations.literal: Raiding General Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yizhou: in all editions "Yuan Hong" reads "Yuan Lang."
translations.idiomatic: Raiding General Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Yizhou: in all editions "Yuan Hong" reads "Yuan Lang."

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「垣閬，大明三年已為竟陵王誕所殺，見垣護之傳。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "Yuan Lang had already been killed by Prince Dan of Jingling in the third year of Daming; see the biography of Yuan Hu'zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "Yuan Lang had already been killed by Prince Dan of Jingling in the third year of Daming; see the biography of Yuan Hu'zhi.

sentences.zh: 此為垣閎之誤。

translations.literal: This is an error for Yuan Hong.
translations.idiomatic: This is an error for Yuan Hong.

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Zhang, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " According to Zhang, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞羊希為廣州刺史 「羊希」各本並作「羊南」，據羊玄保傳，兄子希時由御史中丞出為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Attendant Censor Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guangzhou: in all editions "Yang Xi" reads "Yang Nan"; according to the biography of Yang Xuanbao, his nephew Xi was then transferred from Attendant Censor to Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Yang Xi was made Inspector of Guangzhou: in all editions "Yang Xi" reads "Yang Nan"; according to the biography of Yang Xuanbao, his nephew Xi was then transferred from Attendant Censor to Inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 「南」字誤，今改正。

translations.literal: The character "Nan" is wrong, and the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The character "Nan" is wrong, and the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 珍奇子超越為北冀州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「劉勔傳，超越為北豫州刺史，非北冀州。」

translations.literal: Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "In the biography of Liu Mian, Chaoyue was Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji."
translations.idiomatic: Zhenqi's son Chaoyue was made Inspector of Northern Ji: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "In the biography of Liu Mian, Chaoyue was Inspector of Northern Yu, not Northern Ji."

sentences.zh: 右光祿大夫車騎將軍護軍將軍王玄謨薨 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「右光祿大夫」，局本及王玄謨傳作「左光祿大夫」。

translations.literal: Right Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died: the Three Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Palace edition read "Right Grand Master"; the Bureau edition and the biography of Wang Xuanmo read "Left Grand Master."
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and General Who Protects the Army Wang Xuanmo died: the Three Dynasties edition, Northern Directorate edition, Mao edition, and Palace edition read "Right Grand Master"; the Bureau edition and the biography of Wang Xuanmo read "Left Grand Master."

sentences.zh: 三月己未 下有戊辰。

translations.literal: Third month, jiwei day: below there is wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiwei day: below there is wuchen.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙子朔，無己未、戊辰。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on bingzi; there are no jiwei or wuchen.
translations.idiomatic: According to the calendar, that month began on bingzi; there are no jiwei or wuchen.

sentences.zh: 二十日乙未，二十三日戊戌。

translations.literal: The twentieth day is yimou and the twenty-third day is wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth day is yimou and the twenty-third day is wuxu.

sentences.zh: 己未或乙未之譌，戊辰或戊戌之譌。

translations.literal: Jiwei may be a corruption of yimou, and wuchen a corruption of wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei may be a corruption of yimou, and wuchen a corruption of wuxu.

sentences.zh: 以軍司馬劉靈遺為梁南秦二州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「軍上脫一字。」

translations.literal: Army Marshal Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "One character is missing above army."
translations.idiomatic: Army Marshal Liu Lingyi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "One character is missing above army."

sentences.zh: 南譙太守孫奉伯為交州刺史 「南譙」各本並作「譙南」，據州郡志訂正。

translations.literal: Nanqiao Administrator Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiaozhou: in all editions "Nanqiao" reads "Qiaonan"; corrected according to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Nanqiao Administrator Sun Fengbo was made Inspector of Jiaozhou: in all editions "Nanqiao" reads "Qiaonan"; corrected according to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies.

sentences.zh: 殺刺史羊希 「羊希」各本並譌「羊南」，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑及本書羊玄保傳兄子希附傳改正。

translations.literal: Inspector Yang Xi was killed: in all editions "Yang Xi" is written wrongly as "Yang Nan"; corrected according to the Nan shi, Jiankang shilu, Zizhi tongjian, and the attached biography of nephew Xi in the biography of Yang Xuanbao in this book.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Yang Xi was killed: in all editions "Yang Xi" is written wrongly as "Yang Nan"; corrected according to the Nan shi, Jiankang shilu, Zizhi tongjian, and the attached biography of nephew Xi in the biography of Yang Xuanbao in this book.

sentences.zh: 復減郡縣田祿之半 「田祿」各本及通鑑並作「田租」。

translations.literal: Again reduced by half the field stipends of commanderies and counties: in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian "field stipends" reads "field tax."
translations.idiomatic: Again reduced by half the field stipends of commanderies and counties: in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian "field stipends" reads "field tax."

sentences.zh: 按普減國內田租之半，決非專制帝王之所肯為，當是減削郡縣官吏田祿之半。

translations.literal: According to the principle, a general reduction of field tax throughout the realm by half is certainly not what a despotic emperor would willingly do; it must be a reduction by half of the field stipends of commandery and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: According to the principle, a general reduction of field tax throughout the realm by half is certainly not what a despotic emperor would willingly do; it must be a reduction by half of the field stipends of commandery and county officials.

sentences.zh: 建康實錄作「田祿」，是。

translations.literal: The Jiankang shilu reads "field stipends," which is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang shilu reads "field stipends," which is correct.

sentences.zh: 今據改。

translations.literal: Now corrected accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Now corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 丙申東海王褘改封廬江王 各本並脫去「丙申」二字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang: all editions omit the two characters bingxu; supplied from the Nan shi and Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Prince Hui of Donghai was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Lujiang: all editions omit the two characters bingxu; supplied from the Nan shi and Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳 各本並作「乙未」，按是月乙巳朔，無乙未。

translations.literal: Fifth month, yisi day: all editions read yimou; according to the calendar that month began on yisi, and there is no yimou.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi day: all editions read yimou; according to the calendar that month began on yisi, and there is no yimou.

sentences.zh: 下有十九日癸亥。

translations.literal: Below there is the nineteenth day, guihai.
translations.idiomatic: Below there is the nineteenth day, guihai.

sentences.zh: 此乙未當是乙巳之誤，今改正。

translations.literal: This yimou must be an error for yisi, and the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: This yimou must be an error for yisi, and the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 以南康相劉勃為交州刺史 張森楷校勘記云：「劉勔傳，有弟斅，泰始中，為寧朔將軍、交州刺史，於道遇病卒。

translations.literal: Nankang Chancellor Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiaozhou: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "In the biography of Liu Mian there is a younger brother Jiao; in the Taishi era he was Ning Shuo General and Inspector of Jiaozhou, and died of illness on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang Chancellor Liu Bo was made Inspector of Jiaozhou: Zhang Senkai's collation notes say: "In the biography of Liu Mian there is a younger brother Jiao; in the Taishi era he was Ning Shuo General and Inspector of Jiaozhou, and died of illness on the road.

sentences.zh: 勃、斅形近，當即一人。」

translations.literal: Bo and Jiao are graphically similar and must be the same man."
translations.idiomatic: Bo and Jiao are graphically similar and must be the same man."

sentences.zh: 以輔國將軍沈文靖為東青州刺史 「沈文靖」沈文秀傳及通鑑作「沈文靜」。

translations.literal: Fu Guo General Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qingzhou: the biography of Shen Wenxiu and the Zizhi tongjian read Shen Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Guo General Shen Wenjing was made Inspector of Eastern Qingzhou: the biography of Shen Wenxiu and the Zizhi tongjian read Shen Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 尋劫制科罪 「劫」各本並作「剏」。

translations.literal: Soon after, plunder was prohibited and punished by statute: in all editions "plunder" reads "create."
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, plunder was prohibited and punished by statute: in all editions "plunder" reads "create."

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「當云劫制，剏字誤。

translations.literal: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "It should read plunder; the character create is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Biao's Critical Essays on the Song shu say: "It should read plunder; the character create is wrong.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " According to Sun, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " According to Sun, this is correct, and the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 立晉平王休祐子宣曜為南平王 各本並脫「立」字，據南史、建康實錄補。

translations.literal: Prince Xiuyou of Jinping's son Xuanyao was established as Prince of Nanping: all editions omit the character "establish"; supplied from the Nan shi and Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiuyou of Jinping's son Xuanyao was established as Prince of Nanping: all editions omit the character "establish"; supplied from the Nan shi and Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 息事衡樊 「息」各本並作「自」，據元龜二一三及六四五改正。

translations.literal: Live quietly in their orchards and gardens: in all editions "live" reads "from"; corrected according to Yuan Gui 213 and 645.
translations.idiomatic: Live quietly in their orchards and gardens: in all editions "live" reads "from"; corrected according to Yuan Gui 213 and 645.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍孟次陽為兗州刺史 各本並脫「次」字，據阮佃夫傳、殷琰傳補。

translations.literal: Fu Shi General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yanzhou: all editions omit the character "Ci"; supplied from the biographies of Ruan Tianfu and Yin Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Shi General Meng Ciyang was made Inspector of Yanzhou: all editions omit the character "Ci"; supplied from the biographies of Ruan Tianfu and Yin Yan.

sentences.zh: 以征北大將軍南徐州刺史桂陽王休範為中書監中軍將軍揚州刺史 「中軍將軍」各本並作「中將軍」，據桂陽王休範傳補。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yangzhou: in all editions "General of the Center Army" reads "Center General"; supplied from the biography of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Prince Xiufan of Guiyang was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, General of the Center Army, and Inspector of Yangzhou: in all editions "General of the Center Army" reads "Center General"; supplied from the biography of Prince Xiufan of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 輔師將軍建安王世子伯融為廣州刺史 各本並脫「伯」字。

translations.literal: Fu Shi General Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was made Inspector of Guangzhou: all editions omit the character "Bo."
translations.idiomatic: Fu Shi General Heir Apparent Bairong of Jian'an was made Inspector of Guangzhou: all editions omit the character "Bo."

sentences.zh: 據始安王休仁傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied from the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied from the biography of Prince Xiuren of Shian.

sentences.zh: 新除吏部尚書褚淵為尚書右僕射 「右僕射」各本及通鑑並作「左僕射」。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing: in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian "Right Vice Director" reads "Left Vice Director."
translations.idiomatic: Newly appointed Minister of Personnel Chu Yuan was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing: in all editions and the Zizhi tongjian "Right Vice Director" reads "Left Vice Director."

sentences.zh: 今據南齊書褚淵傳、南史、建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Now changed according to the biography of Chu Yuan in the Qi shu, the Nan shi, and the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Now changed according to the biography of Chu Yuan in the Qi shu, the Nan shi, and the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊午 「十一月」各本並作「十月」。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day: in all editions "eleventh month" reads "tenth month."
translations.idiomatic: Winter, eleventh month, wuwu day: in all editions "eleventh month" reads "tenth month."

sentences.zh: 據建康實錄改。

translations.literal: Changed according to the Jiankang shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Changed according to the Jiankang shilu.

sentences.zh: 按十月丙戌朔，無戊午。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, the tenth month began on bingxu; there is no wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: According to the calendar, the tenth month began on bingxu; there is no wuwu.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，初四日戊午。

translations.literal: The eleventh month began on yimao; the fourth day is wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month began on yimao; the fourth day is wuwu.

sentences.zh: 以右衞將軍張興世為雍州刺史 各本並脫「世」字。

translations.literal: Colonel of the Right Guard Zhang Xingshi was made Inspector of Yong: all editions omit the character "shi."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xingshi, Colonel of the Right Guard, was appointed Inspector of Yong; every edition omits the final character of his name.

sentences.zh: 據張興世傳補。

translations.literal: Supplied according to the biography of Zhang Xingshi.
translations.idiomatic: The missing character is restored from his biography.

sentences.zh: 於華林園含芳堂講周易 各本並脫「含」字，據元龜一九二補。

translations.literal: Lectured on the Zhouyi in Fragrant Hall in Huangling Garden: all editions omit the character "contain"; supplied from Yuan Gui 192.
translations.idiomatic: He lectured on the Zhouyi in Fragrant Hall in Huangling Garden; all editions drop the word "Fragrant," restored from Yuan Gui 192.

sentences.zh: 改騧為馬邊瓜 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本無「馬」字，今據局本及魏書島夷傳、南史補。

translations.literal: Changed gua to melon by the horse track: the Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions lack the character horse; now supplied according to the Bureau edition and the biography of the island barbarians in the Wei shu and the Nan shi.
translations.idiomatic: The text changes gua to "melon by the horse track"; the Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Hall editions omit "horse," now restored from the Bureau edition and parallel passages in the Wei shu and Nan shi.

sentences.zh: 職局以之坐者數十人 魏書島夷傳、南史、建康實錄「坐」下有「死」字。

translations.literal: Several tens in the office staff were punished for it: the biography of the island barbarians in the Wei shu, the Nan shi, and the Jiankang shilu have the character death below punished.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen office staff were punished; the Wei shu, Nan shi, and Jiankang shilu add the word "death" after "punished."

sentences.zh: 並日料祿俸 各本並同。

translations.literal: Daily ration of salary stipends: all editions are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Daily salary allotments: all received texts agree.

sentences.zh: 魏書島夷傳作「普斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The biography of the island barbarians in the Wei shu reads universally cut off salary stipends.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei shu biography of the island barbarians reads "salary stipends universally cut off."

sentences.zh: 南史及通鑑作「並斷祿奉」。

translations.literal: The Nan shi and Zizhi tongjian read together cut off salary stipends.
translations.idiomatic: The Nan shi and Zizhi tongjian read "salary stipends cut off together."

sentences.zh: 列見眾篇 三朝本作「列」。

translations.literal: Set forth in the various chapters: the Three Dynasties edition reads set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Set forth in the various chapters: the Three Dynasties edition has "set forth."

sentences.zh: 北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「別」。

translations.literal: The Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read separate.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Directorate, Mao, Hall, and Bureau editions read "separate."

sentences.zh: 張元濟校勘記云：「所見處不止一篇，故云列見眾篇。」

translations.literal: Zhang Yuanji's collation notes say: Where seen, it is not limited to one chapter, hence it says set forth in the various chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuanji notes: "The phrase appears in more than one chapter, which is why the text says it is set forth in the various chapters."

sentences.zh: 本無卓爾之資 「資」各本作「姿」，據南史改。

translations.literal: Originally he had no outstanding talent: in all editions talent reads bearing; changed according to the Nan shi.
translations.idiomatic: Originally he had no outstanding talent: every edition writes "bearing" for "talent"; the Nan shi reading is adopted.
